title: Executive Assistant — Operations
description:
Please send 30 second video in loom or screen recording to hear your English.

---



## About the Business



Adam Rapoport is a licensed California real estate agent specializing in **probate real estate** across Southern California, active in the space since 2018. His positioning — *"Where Probate Attorneys Stop, I Start"* — reflects a practice built around the legal and procedural complexity of estate sales: navigating probate court timelines, coordinating with attorneys and executors, managing properties under threat of foreclosure, and closing transactions that most agents are unequipped to handle.



Alongside his brokerage work, Adam operates **Atomic Group Development LLC**, an acquisition and assignment vehicle for estate properties that aren't retail-ready.



This is a **high-volume, detail-intensive, deadline-driven business.** Probate transactions run on court schedules, statutory notice periods, and hard filing deadlines — there is very little room for dropped balls.



---



## Why This Role Exists



Adam is the rainmaker, negotiator, and legal-strategy mind of the business — the parts of the job that require his license, his relationships, and his judgment. Everything *around* those things — the coordination, the tracking, the follow-through, the paperwork choreography — is currently absorbing time and attention that should be going toward selling and prospecting.



The right Executive Assistant takes ownership of the operational engine so Adam can stay focused on the front-of-house work only he can do.



---



## What This Role Owns



**Transaction & Case Coordination**

- Track active probate listings and estate files across multiple courts and counties (currently San Bernardino, with matters spanning multiple case types: foreclosure-threatened sales, ex parte applications, permit verifications)

- Maintain a master status tracker for every active file — key dates, pending actions, outstanding documents, responsible parties

- Monitor statutory and court deadlines (e.g., notice periods, hearing dates, trustee sale dates) and flag upcoming deadlines well in advance

- Coordinate document packages (listing agreements, notice filings, disclosures) between Adam, attorneys, title/escrow, and executors



**CRM & Pipeline Management**

- Own day-to-day operation of GoHighLevel (GHL) — nurture sequences, follow-up tasks, SMS/email campaigns

- Keep PropertyRadar and Vulcan7 lead lists current, organized, and actionable

- Manage lead intake, data hygiene, and follow-up cadences so nothing warm goes cold



**Marketing & Social Media**

- **Build out and manage Adam's social media presence** — this is a growth responsibility, not just maintenance: content calendar, post creation/scheduling, basic graphic/video assembly, captions, and engagement 
, Instagram, and any other relevant platforms)

- Maintain and update the probate marketing suite (pre-listing packages, business cards, SMS/MMS assets, comparison sheets)

- Coordinate with designers/AI tools on revisions using prepared briefs

- Manage and optimize Google Business Profile



**Calendar & Communication**

- Own Adam's calendar with ruthless protection of his early-morning study/prospecting blocks

- Triage inbox and calls; draft routine correspondence for his review (grammar-clean, in his voice — not rewritten)

- Prepare him for calls and meetings with a one-glance briefing



**Document & Systems Management**

- Keep files named, filed, and organized (Google Drive, Glide, CRMLS) using consistent, logical systems

- Manage e-signature workflows (Docusign) — sending, tracking, following up on outstanding signatures



**As the Business Evolves**

- Support additional systems and process build-out as transaction volume grows



---



## What This Role Does *Not* Own



- Client-facing negotiation or advice (Adam's license, Adam's judgment)

- Legal interpretation or filings requiring an attorney

- Final say on marketing voice/positioning — EA executes and maintains, doesn't originate brand strategy



---



## Ideal Candidate Profile



**Non-negotiables**

- **Excellent spoken and written English.** This person will be drafting client- and attorney-facing communication and may occasionally need to speak with US contacts by phone — fluency needs to be strong enough that it's not a barrier or a tell.

- **Extremely organized and deadline-obsessed.** This business runs on court dates and statutory windows. Someone who is "pretty organized" is not enough — this person needs to treat deadlines the way a paralegal or surgical scheduler would.

- **Comfortable with ambiguity and legal/procedural complexity.** Probate isn't formulaic; the right person can hold multiple open threads (a foreclosure postponement, an ex parte hearing, a permit dispute) without losing the plot.

- **Strong written communication.** Will be drafting and cleaning up client- and attorney-facing communication.

- **Social media / content instincts.** Comfortable building out a business page from scratch — not just scheduling posts someone else designed, but having a sense of what makes real estate content engaging.

- **Tech-comfortable, not tech-intimidated.** GHL, PropertyRadar, Vulcan7, Docusign, Google Workspace, CRMLS — willingness to learn systems quickly matters more than prior exposure to these specific tools.

- **Discretion.** This role touches estate, financial, and sometimes sensitive family-conflict information.



**Strongly preferred**

- Prior experience in real estate operations, transaction coordination, or a legal/paralegal support role (probate, estate, or title/escrow experience is a major plus)

- Experience managing a CRM and follow-up sequences, not just data entry

- A track record of *proactively* catching things before they become problems — not just executing assigned tasks



**Working style fit**

- Adam is direct and prefers the honest read over the soft one — this person should be comfortable pushing back, flagging risk, and saying "this deadline is at risk" without waiting to be asked

- Adam iterates from his own drafts; this person edits and polishes rather than overwrites his voice

- Self-directed — Adam's calendar (especially early mornings) is protected, so this isn't a role that leans on constant real-time check-ins



---



## Role Logistics



- **Location:** Philippines-based, fully remote

- **Hours:** 20–30 hrs/week

- **Compensation:** $600/month (flat rate, not hourly — clarify with candidates whether this is fixed regardless of the 20–30 hr range, or scales within it)

- **Schedule:** 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific Time, worked within that window for a total of 20–30 hrs/week (not necessarily the full 9-hour span every day). In Philippine time, that converts to roughly **10:00 PM – 7:00 AM** (shifting to ~11:00 PM – 8:00 AM once Pacific time falls back to standard time in November) — meaning this is effectively a **night shift** for a PH-based candidate. That's a normal and common shift pattern in the Philippines given the BPO industry, but it's worth stating clearly in the posting so candidates self-select accurately rather than discovering it after being hired.

title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
description:
Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper

Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines





Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Engagement Type: Long-term Independent Contractor

Service Days: Monday to Friday

Reports To: Australian Client Manager

Client Contact: No direct client communication required



About the Role



We are an Australian accounting practice seeking an experienced Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a portfolio of Australian clients.

This is a hands-on, non-client-facing role. You will work directly with an Australian Client Manager, who will manage all external client communication and provide instructions, priorities and review feedback.



You will be responsible for delivering accurate bookkeeping, payroll, BAS/IAS preparation, reconciliations, month-end work and accounting support across multiple Australian entities.

This opportunity is suitable only for candidates with substantial recent experience working within, or directly supporting, an Australian accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or public practice environment.



Key ResponsibilitiesBookkeeping and Reconciliations

· Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Complete bank, credit card, loan and merchant facility reconciliations.

· Reconcile payment platforms such as Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify and Wise.

· Process accounts payable and accounts receivable.

· Process supplier bills, sales invoices, credit notes, refunds and payments.

· Review aged receivables and aged payables.

· Process journals, accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments.

· Reconcile director, shareholder, beneficiary and intercompany loan accounts.

· Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation schedules.

· Investigate unreconciled, duplicated, missing or incorrectly recorded transactions.



Account Code and GST Code Review



This is a senior-level role. You must be able to review the quality and technical accuracy of bookkeeping work.



You will be required to:



· Review and correct account codes.

· Review and correct GST tax codes.

· Identify incorrect use of GST on Income, GST on Expenses, GST-Free, Input Taxed and BAS Excluded codes.

· Review the GST treatment of overseas transactions, exports, reimbursements, disbursements, insurance payments and government grants.

· Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions.

· Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications.

· Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts.

· Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager.

· Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required.



Australian Payroll



· Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll.

· Set up and maintain employee payroll records.

· Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements.

· Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments.

· Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation.

· Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding.

· Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation.

· Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts.

· Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts.

· Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements.



BAS, IAS and Compliance Support



· Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review.

· Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts.

· Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods.

· Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger.

· Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments.

· Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations.

· Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports.

· Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents.

· Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly.



Month-End and Year-End



· Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files.

· Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts.

· Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities.

· Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals.

· Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off.

· Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable.

· Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules.

· Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation.



Financial Reporting



· Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

· Prepare cash flow and management reports where required.

· Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts.

· Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors.

· Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager.



Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential



Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage.



Relevant experience may include:

· Individual and sole trader tax returns.

· Company tax returns.

· Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers.

· Partnership tax returns.

· Rental property schedules.

· Depreciation and capital allowance schedules.

· Tax reconciliation workpapers.

· Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL.



Essential Experience and Skills



Applicants must have:

· At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience.

· Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Advanced practical experience using Xero.

· Strong practical experience using MYOB.

· Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online.

· Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers.

· Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding.

· Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes.

· Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience.

· Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

· Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

· High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

· Ability to use AI tools



Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement.



Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly regarded:

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.

· Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping.

· CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies.

· Xero Advisor Certification.

· MYOB or QuickBooks certification.



Software



You must be confident using:



· Xero

· MYOB

· QuickBooks Online



Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position.



The contractor will:



· Provide services remotely from the Philippines.

· Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements.

· Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations.

· Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice.



The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours.



The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met.



Timesheets and Work Records



The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording:



· Date.

· Client or entity.

· Task performed.

· Time spent.

· Work completed.

· Outstanding issues and next steps.



Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records.

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



· A reliable computer or laptop.

· Stable high-speed internet.

· Backup internet.

· A quiet and secure home office.

· A suitable headset for online meetings.

· The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems.

· A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security.



How to Apply



Please submit:

· Your current resume.

· A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience.

· Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience.

· Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience.

· Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared.

· Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos.

· Your earliest available commencement date.

· Confirmation of your internet.

· Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor.



Pay: Php60,000.00 - Php70,000.00 per month

title: Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller (List Builder)
description:
Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience Required: 1–2 Years



Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Make outbound cold calls to commercial property owners, landlords, investors, asset managers, and brokers across asset classes (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, mixed-use)

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Follow call scripts while keeping conversations natural, credible, and tailored to commercial owners

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as Prop Stream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role



Competitive base salary — get rewarded for showing up and doing the work

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins



Ready to Make Your Calls Count?



Send your updated resume and a short recording (Loom or Vocaroo — link only)

description:
Remote Fleet Operations Manager — U.S. Car Rental Company



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Eastern Time



We are a rapidly growing U.S.-based private car rental company.



We currently own 17 vehicles and are actively expanding, with a goal of reaching 50 vehicles by December 2026.



We are looking for a highly capable Fleet Operations Manager who can help the owner organize, systemize, and eventually manage the day-to-day operation of the company.



This is NOT a basic Virtual Assistant position.



We want someone who thinks like an operator, solves problems independently, builds systems, and wants to grow into a leadership position.



YOUR ROLE



You will work directly with the owner initially and progressively take responsibility for daily fleet operations.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Managing customer inquiries and following up with rental leads

*
 Marketplace/Messenger customer communication

* Screening and qualifying prospective renters

* Coordinating reservations and vehicle availability

* Managing rental agreements and customer documentation

* Tracking rental payments, security deposits, extensions, and overdue balances

* Managing late renters and overdue vehicles according to company procedures

* Coordinating vehicle pickups and returns

* Tracking every vehicle’s operational status

* Coordinating mechanics, repair shops, towing, cleaning, and other vendors

* Tracking preventative maintenance, mileage, registration, and insurance status

* Tracking tolls, tickets, parking violations, and renter responsibility

* Managing accident/damage documentation and assisting with claims administration

* Maintaining accurate customer and vehicle records

* Maintaining the company’s fleet dashboard and CRM

* Creating and improving Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

* Producing a concise daily operations report for the owner

* Eventually helping hire, train, and supervise additional support staff



WHO WE WANT



Direct experience with Turo, private car rentals, vehicle fleets, dealerships, automotive operations, or rideshare rental fleets is strongly preferred.



You should have:



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong organizational skills

* Strong customer-service skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Experience with Google Sheets

* Experience with CRM or operations-management software

* Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time

* Ability to manage multiple problems simultaneously

* Strong judgment and problem-solving skills

* Ability to create clear processes and SOPs

* Confidence communicating with customers, mechanics, vendors, and team members



Most importantly:



We want someone who takes ownership.



When something goes wrong, your first response should be:



“How do I solve this?”



—not—



“Let me ask the owner what to do.”



There will always be situations that require escalation, but the goal is to build an operation that does not depend on the owner handling every routine decision.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



This is intended to be a long-term position.



As the fleet grows, the successful candidate can grow into:



Head of Fleet Operations



You may eventually supervise customer-service VAs, administrative staff, and local fleet personnel.



We are building the management team now while the company is growing.



COMPENSATION



$5–$7 USD/hour to start, depending on experience and ability.



Full-time opportunity.



Performance bonuses and compensation growth will be available as responsibilities and fleet size increase.



Exceptional candidates with substantial fleet-management experience may be considered above this range.



?



HOW TO APPLY



Please do NOT send only a generic résumé or copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with the words:



“FLEET 50”



Then answer ALL of the following questions.



1. CAR RENTAL EXPERIENCE



Have you personally worked for:



* Turo host

* Private car-rental company

* Rideshare/gig-driver rental fleet

* Dealership

* Fleet-management company

* Automotive company



If yes, explain:



How many vehicles were in the fleet?



What exactly were YOU responsible for?



Be specific.



2. SOFTWARE & SYSTEMS



Tell us which of the following you have personally used:



* Turo

*
 Marketplace

*
 Messenger

* Google Sheets

* CRM systems

* Fleet-management software

* GPS tracking systems

* Payment-processing systems

* Project-management software

* Automation software



Tell us what you actually did with each system.



3. OPERATIONS TEST



Imagine you are responsible for a 20-car rental fleet.



It is Friday at 7:30 PM.



Vehicle #8: Supposed to return at 6:00 PM. The renter isn’t responding.



Problem: Another customer is scheduled to receive Vehicle #8 Saturday at 9:00 AM.



At the same time:



Vehicle #12: The renter reports that a warning light just appeared.



And:



Vehicle #4: The renter wants to extend another seven days but has unpaid toll charges.



The owner is unavailable.



Explain exactly what you would do, in order.



We care more about your reasoning than having one “perfect” answer.



4. LATE PAYMENT TEST



A renter is two days late paying.



They keep saying:



“I’ll have the money tomorrow.”



The renter still has the vehicle and continues driving it.



Explain how you would manage the situation from beginning to resolution.



5. BUILDING SYSTEMS



You join a growing rental company where many procedures currently exist only in the owner’s head.



What are the first five systems/processes you would build or document?



Explain why you chose them.



6. SOP TEST



Write a short Standard Operating Procedure for:



Vehicle Return ? Vehicle Inspection ? Preparing Vehicle for the Next Renter



Keep it simple but operational.



7. VIDEO INTRODUCTION



Please provide a 2–3 minute video introduction explaining:



* Who you are

* Your relevant experience

* Why you believe you can help operate this company

* The largest fleet you’ve worked with

* One thing you would immediately improve when joining a rapidly growing rental fleet



IMPORTANT



We’re not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks.



We’re looking for someone who can eventually run the operation, build systems, solve problems, manage people, and help us scale from a small fleet into a professionally managed rental company.



If you’re looking for a long-term opportunity where your responsibilities and compensation can grow significantly with the company, we’d like to hear from you.



Remember to start your application with: FLEET 50

description:
# Real Estate Transaction Coordinator & Executive Assistant (Per-Contract)



**A St. Louis, Missouri Realtor**

**Pay: $6–$9/hour, DOE**

**Schedule: Per-contract, as-needed — you're engaged for each client's full closing period (typically 28–40 days), with responsiveness expected during US Central business hours throughout that window**



## About the Role



I'm a St. Louis, Missouri Realtor looking for an experienced Real Estate Transaction Coordinator who can also operate as a right-hand Executive Assistant. For each client we bring on, you'll own the communication and coordination from contract to closing (typically a 28–40 day window) — keeping the deal on track and acting as the first point of contact when agents, buyers, sellers, investors, title companies, lenders, and inspectors need something handled quickly.



This is not an entry-level data-entry role. We need someone who already understands US real estate transactions, can fill out and proofread contracts accurately, and can be trusted to represent me professionally in every
 and text. Work comes in per transaction rather than as a fixed weekly schedule, so the number of active files — and your hours — will scale with how many clients we have under contract at a given time. If you do great work here, there is real room to grow into a broader, more consistent assistant role over time.



## What You'll Be Doing



- Coordinating real estate transactions end-to-end: opening files, tracking deadlines, and following every contract through to closing

- Filling out, reviewing, and proofreading purchase agreements, disclosures, and other contract paperwork for accuracy and completeness

s and texts

title: Outbound Appointment Setter- U.S. Health Insurance
description:
Outbound Appointment Setter – U.S. Health Insurance Agency

Remote | Philippines Preferred | Long-Term Opportunity | Base Pay + Performance Bonuses



We are a growing U.S.-based health insurance agency looking for a confident, energetic, and highly motivated Outbound Appointment Setter to join our team.



This is NOT a customer service or administrative VA position.



Your primary job is simple: TALK TO PEOPLE AND SET QUALIFIED APPOINTMENTS.



We provide the leads. You call them, start conversations, qualify their interest, overcome basic objections, and schedule qualified prospects to speak with one of our licensed health insurance agents.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable being on the phone, isn't afraid of rejection, has a great personality, and knows how to turn a conversation into an appointment.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



• Making high-volume outbound calls to leads we provide

• Following up with new, old, and previously contacted leads

• Speaking with U.S.-based consumers about their interest in health coverage

• Following a proven calling and qualification script

• Handling basic objections professionally

• Identifying genuinely interested prospects

• Scheduling qualified appointments directly onto our agents' calendars

• Confirming appointments and following up with prospects

• Accurately documenting calls, conversations, and outcomes in our CRM

• Tracking daily performance including calls, contacts, appointments, and show rates

• Working closely with our sales team to continuously improve results



IMPORTANT



You are NOT responsible for selling health insurance.



You will not quote insurance plans, recommend coverage, explain detailed benefits, or close sales.



Your responsibility is to identify interested prospects, gather basic information, and schedule them with a licensed insurance agent.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who:



✓ Speaks excellent, clear, easy-to-understand English

✓ Sounds natural and conversational — NOT robotic or scripted

✓ Is confident speaking with Americans on the phone

✓ Has a friendly, upbeat, professional personality

✓ Is comfortable making 100–150+ outbound calls per day

✓ Isn't discouraged by rejection

✓ Can confidently handle basic objections

✓ Is competitive and motivated by results

✓ Is reliable and shows up when scheduled

✓ Can follow a script while still sounding natural

✓ Is coachable and willing to improve

✓ Can accurately document conversations in a CRM

✓ Has reliable high-speed internet

✓ Has a quality headset and quiet workspace

✓ Can work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours



EXPERIENCE



Previous experience in any of the following is strongly preferred:



• Appointment setting

• Outbound sales

• U.S. call center

• Insurance

• Medicare / Final Expense

• Mortgage

• Solar

• Real estate

• Lead generation

• High-ticket sales

• Telemarketing



Health insurance experience is a PLUS, but it is not required.



I'd rather hire someone who is GREAT on the phone and train them than hire someone with insurance experience who can't hold a conversation.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



We don't judge success simply by how many calls you make.



We track:



Dials → Contacts → Conversations → Qualified Appointments → Shows → Sales



Our goal is not to fill our calendar with bad appointments.



Our goal is to create qualified appointments with people who genuinely want to speak with an insurance professional.



COMPENSATION



Base Pay + Performance Bonuses



Starting compensation will depend on experience and demonstrated ability.



We are open to approximately $5–$7 USD/hour for the right candidate, plus opportunities to earn additional performance bonuses based on qualified appointments, show rates, and results.



There is opportunity for increased compensation and responsibility for someone who consistently performs.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are building a growing sales organization, and this is NOT intended to be a temporary position.



We are starting with appointment setters for our current sales operation, but as our sales team grows, we expect our appointment-setting team to grow with it.



Someone who becomes a top performer could eventually have opportunities for additional responsibility, higher compensation, and potentially helping train or manage additional appointment setters.



We want someone who wants to grow WITH us.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send ALL of the following:



1. Resume



Send your current resume showing your previous work experience.



2. 60–90 Second Video Introduction



Tell me:



• Your name

• Where you live

• Your previous work experience

• Your experience making outbound calls

• Why you think you'd be great at this position



3. Voice Recording



Record yourself saying the following as if you were actually speaking to a potential customer:



"Hi Sarah, this is [YOUR NAME] calling on behalf of Mike with The Tattooed Health Dude. You had previously requested information about health coverage options, and I'm just reaching out to see if you're still looking for coverage or if you've already found something?"



Do NOT simply read it.



Pretend Sarah just answered the phone.



I want to hear your personality.



4. Answer These Questions



Please include answers to ALL of the following:



How many years of outbound calling experience do you have?

What industries have you called for?

Approximately how many outbound calls did you make per day?

How many appointments were you typically able to set per day/week?

Have you worked with U.S.-based customers before?

Have you worked in insurance before? If so, what type?

What CRMs or dialers have you used?

Are you comfortable making 100–150+ calls per day?

Are you available to work U.S. Eastern Time hours?

What is your expected hourly/monthly compensation?

What type of internet connection do you have?

Do you have backup internet and/or backup power?

ONE LAST THING...



To prove you actually read the entire job posting, put:



"I'M READY TO DIAL"



at the very beginning of your application.



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be considered.



We're looking for someone who is hungry, positive, competitive, reliable, and ready to grow with a winning team.



If that's you, I want to hear from you.



The Tattooed Health Dude

U.S. Health Insurance Sales Team

title: E-Commerce Visual Content Specialist
description:
E-Commerce Visual Content Specialist

Canva, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude experience required.

Remote — Philippines | Full-Time | Brace Direct & RevUp Sports



We are seeking a detail oriented, analytical E-Commerce Visual Content Specialist to produce and test listing imagery for our two e-commerce businesses: Brace Direct, an orthopedic bracing and medical device company, and RevUp Sports, an athletic shoes and apparel company.

You will turn raw product photography into listing-ready marketing images and get them live across Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, eBay, and our B2B dealer portal — working inside our existing brand templates in Canva, and using ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude to generate backgrounds, build lifestyle scenes, and clean up source photos.

This role leans analytical, not artistic. AI does most of the drawing. You supply the judgment: the prompt that gets a usable result on the second try, the catch when the model gets a detail wrong, the image stack built slot by slot, and the A/B test with a written hypothesis and a tracked outcome. Expect accurate daily data entry alongside it — SKUs, ASINs, file names, test dates, and results. If that part sounds tedious to you, this is not your role.

This is not a blank-canvas design role. Our customers are often in pain, recovering from surgery, and shopping on a phone. The images that win here answer their real question — which side does it fit, will it show under clothing, how do I size it.



↓ See Application Instructions at the Bottom! ↓



Schedule

4 hours of daily overlap with our US Eastern team, scheduled within 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. EST

6 hours of daily overlap during your first two months while you learn our products, brand templates, Amazon requirements, and testing process

Remaining hours are flexible — we do not require a fixed shift outside the overlap window

Manila is 12 hours ahead of US Eastern. A 9:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. EST overlap is 9:00 p.m. – 1:00 a.m. Manila time. We state this upfront so there are no surprises.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Pay: USD $7.50–$8.00/hr ($1,300–$1,385/mo)

Performance Incentive: begins after 90 days — up to 10% of your base pay each month, earned against click-through rate and conversion rate goals on the listings you test. We set your targets with you at the 90-day mark, based on your actual output, so the goals are real and reachable.

Annual pay increases based on performance

Work from home

Flexible time off — we work with you on schedule needs, holidays, and personal time

Full-time, long-term position — not project or freelance work

Key Responsibilities

Turn raw product photography into listing-ready marketing images using our existing Canva brand templates.

Prompt AI image tools — ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude — to generate backgrounds, lifestyle scenes, and cleanup passes, then correct what those tools get wrong.

Build complete image stacks slot by slot — main image, features, benefits, lifestyle, comparison, and instructional graphics — following our repeatable system rather than treating each product as a one-off.

Ensure every image meets Amazon requirements: main image on a pure white background, no text, logos, or props in slot 1, and a minimum of 1600 pixels on the longest side.

Retouch and prepare product photography — background removal, shadowing, straightening, blemish cleanup, and color accuracy across a large catalog.

Upload and publish finished image sets across Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, eBay, and our B2B dealer portal.

Build and launch A/B image tests in Amazon Manage Your Experiments, writing a clear hypothesis for each variant before it goes live.

Track every running and completed test in a shared log — variant, hypothesis, start and end dates, CTR, conversion rate, and which version won.

Report test results weekly and recommend which winning elements should roll out to the rest of the catalog.

Enter and maintain product and image data in spreadsheets with a high degree of accuracy — SKUs, ASINs, file names, image slots, test dates, and status. (This is a daily part of the role, not an occasional one.)

Rename, organize, and archive source and finished files so any asset can be found by SKU without asking anyone.

Audit our live listings for images that are missing, outdated, non-compliant, or below resolution standards, and queue them for rework.

Review competitor listings for image changes on our key products and flag what is worth testing against.

Maintain visual consistency across two brands with different audiences and visual identities.

Learn our product catalog, customers, and systems quickly as the business continues to grow.

Qualifications

2+ years producing e-commerce, marketplace, or product marketing images is required.

Expert-level Canva — specifically working inside established brand templates and keeping to a system — is required.

Daily working use of AI tools, including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, is required. You must be able to write a detailed image prompt and iterate toward a usable result without wasting hours.

Photo editing capability — background removal, retouching, shadowing, and color correction in Photoshop, Photopea, or an equivalent tool — is required.

Strong spreadsheet skills in Google Sheets or Excel, and genuine accuracy on repetitive data entry, is required.

Exceptional attention to detail is required. A brace shown on the wrong leg, or a 1500px main image, is a real cost to us.

Excellent written English is required. Most of our communication is written and asynchronous.

Experience with Amazon listing images and current knowledge of Amazon image requirements is strongly preferred.

Experience building or reading image A/B tests — structuring a single-variable test and interpreting the result — is strongly preferred.

Hands-on experience with Amazon Manage Your Experiments is strongly preferred.

Familiarity with Helium 10 or a comparable Amazon data tool is strongly preferred.

Advanced Photoshop or Illustrator is a plus. We will train the right person on the level we need.

Experience in Shopify, Walmart Seller Center, or eBay backends is a plus. We will train the right person on this.

Experience with medical, orthopedic, wellness, or athletic products is a plus.

Must be dependable, self-motivated, and able to work independently from home.

Reliable power with backup, stable internet with a backup connection, and a computer capable of running Canva and photo editing software without lag.

Ideal Candidate

The best fit is someone who is careful by nature and curious about why one image outsells another. We can teach our brand templates, our catalog, Amazon's rules, and our testing process. What we cannot teach quickly is attention to detail and the judgment to look at an AI-generated image and know it is not usable — the shadow falls the wrong way, the strap is mirrored, the hand has six fingers, the product geometry drifted. AI will do most of the drawing here. You are the person who decides whether it is right.

We are a hands-on, entrepreneurial company. Team members are expected to think for themselves, spot problems, suggest better ways of doing things, and take ownership. Some of our best improvements come from the people doing the work every day. If you want to be handed a checklist and nothing else, this is not the role. If you want to run tests, see the numbers move, and have your findings change how we sell across the whole catalog, it is.

We are also looking for someone who can grow. As our testing volume increases, the person in this role may own the image-testing calendar and set the standards others follow. If you have ambitions beyond executing on your own, we want to hear about them.



Application Instructions

Please apply on Indeed or Onlinejobs. Our hiring process is:

1. Apply on Indeed or Onlinejobs. All legitimate correspondence from Brace Direct will come from 
 address or through Indeed.

2. You will receive a link to a TestGorilla assessment. A passing score is required to continue.

3. Amy will
 you to request your portfolio.

4. Phone interview with Shirl.

6. Final interview with Nathan, Founder of Brace Direct.

Test Gorilla

After your Indeed Application, complete the job assessment here:



Benefits

Work from home

Performance incentive program after 90 days — up to 10% of base pay

Flexible time off

Annual pay increases

Full-time, long-term — not project work

title: Busy SEO Content Solopreneur Seeks a Consistent Content Operator Who Communicates
description:
I run SEO content for 4 clients. Every month, 28 pages have to get written, edited, illustrated, published, and logged on time, every time, without me chasing anyone.



I need one person to own that entire loop. This is not a "get 28 pages live on schedule with zero drama" job.



The monthly load

Client A — 4 pages, B2B service

Client B — 2 pages, B2C service for kids

Client C — 2 pages, B2B/B2C product

Client D — 20 pages, real estate



What each post actually involves

1. Take the brief. I give you the topic, keyword, and angle. The calendar is locked before the month starts.

2. Run it through the prompt library to generate a draft.

3. Edit that draft into something a real person would want to read. This is the part I care about most.

4. Choose and size 4-12 images per page in Canva, to brand spec.

5. Publish in the client's CMS: meta title, meta description, H1, internal links, alt text, page slug, post category, featured image, in-text images.

6. Log the live URL in Asana and check off the task



What you already need to know how to do:

- Publish in a CMS. Our clients use Wordpress, Squarespace, and Sierra. If you've used one CMS seriously, you're trainable on the others.

- Edit AI drafts. We use generative AI. Then we make them better. What I need is someone who can read a draft and immediately see what's generic, what's wrong, what's missing, and what someone actually working in that industry would say and then fix all of it.

- Basic on-page SEO. Meta titles and descriptions, headings, internal linking, alt text, and page paths.

- Basic on-page Design. Pick images from the client library, size them correctly, keep it on brand.

- Use Internal Tools: Asana, Canva, Google Sheets, Slack.

- Write clear, professional English
s to clients. Not perfect English. Clear English with a warm and competent tone. Some clients will eventually
 you directly.



You'll love this job if

- A clean checklist and a calendar full of published content is genuinely satisfying to you

- You'd rather be handed systems, templates, and prompts than invent everything from scratch

- You want the same work, the same clients, and the same team every month, not a new gig scramble every 60 days

- You are consistent and reliable



You'll hate this job if:

- You want creative control over topics and voice. Both are set.

- You are against generative AI.

- You go quiet when you're stuck.

- Volume work bores you into sloppiness.

- You're already juggling many different clients and struggling to keep up



What I give you:

- A tested prompt library, you never start from a blank box

- Client assets: logins, photo libraries, brand guidelines

- A Definition of Done checklist built into Asana, so "finished" is never a matter of opinion

- Topics locked before the month begins

- Make the very first word of your message Thursday in all caps. It tells me you read all the way down here.

- A real ramp: We'll start on 8 posts across 3 clients for the first 90 days, then add in the 4th starting month 4.

- A bi-weekly call, and daily availability on slack. 



Pay

Base: $11 USD/hour — about $264/month your first 90 days,  $924/mo after.

Performance Bonus: up to $96/mo first 90 days, $336/month after



The bonus is not a vague "if I'm happy" bonus. It's four components worth an extra $12 per post, reviewed every month, and every one of them is inside your control:



$4 — Drafts, Edits, and Post are completed by deadline

$4 — No missed checklist requirements

$4 — Beat time goal of 3 hours per post



Other terms

- 13th month bonus every December



Part-time and long-term. I'm looking for someone I work with for years, not months.

Paid Monthly via WISE direct to your account



How hiring works

- Post the Application Below

- A short video call

- A paid trial task for one real post

- Offer



How to apply

Don't waste your credits, just bid minimum. I read all replies. 



Answer each of these in your post.



1. A live URL of a post you both wrote and published yourself. Tell me which CMS, roughly when it went live, and what you did on it beyond typing.



2. Show me your editing. Paste one paragraph of raw AI output, then paste your edited version of that same paragraph. Any topic.



3. What hours can you overlap with 8 AM–5 PM Arizona time? Give me the window in both Arizona time and your local time.



4. Your internet: a Speedtest screenshot, and what your backup is when your main connection goes down.



5. Tell me about the worst piece of content you ever had to fix and what was wrong with it.

description:
We’re looking for a **skilled e-commerce video editor to join our team long-term** and help us produce high-converting direct-response ads for Meta, TikTok, and other paid social platforms.



This is **not a one-off project**. We’re looking for someone who wants consistent work, can handle a steady creative workload, and is interested in **growing with the brand over time**.



You should already have experience editing **e-commerce ads**, including formats such as:



* UGC ads

* VSL-style ads

* Mashups

* Native-style ads

* Advertorial/story-driven creatives

* Direct-response product ads



We’ll provide scripts, raw footage, creative direction, and references. Your job is to turn those assets into ads that **grab attention, maintain retention, and drive conversions.**



### Responsibilities



* Edit raw footage into high-converting direct-response ad creatives

* Turn scripts and creative briefs into finished ads

* Create strong, engaging openings that hook viewers within the first few seconds

* Edit UGC, VSLs, mashups, native ads, and other e-commerce creative formats

* Use B-roll, captions, motion graphics, sound effects, music, pattern interrupts, and visual callouts where appropriate

* Match reference ads while also bringing your own creative judgment to the edit

* Create multiple variations of winning concepts when needed

* Make revisions based on feedback and ad performance

* Maintain **fast and consistent turnaround times**

* Communicate clearly and respond quickly



### Requirements



* **Proven experience editing e-commerce/direct-response ads**

* Strong portfolio of paid social ads you have personally edited

* Experience with **UGC, VSLs, mashups, and performance creatives**

* Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, retention, storytelling, and direct-response editing

* Ability to make an ad feel native to platforms like Meta and TikTok

* Ability to follow detailed creative briefs without needing constant supervision

* Excellent attention to detail

* Reliable communication

* **Fast turnaround — typically 1–3 days depending on the project**

* **Full-time or near full-time availability**

* Ability to handle a consistent volume of creatives every week

* Strong desire to work with us **long-term and grow alongside the brand**



### What We Provide



* Finished scripts and ad angles

* Raw footage and UGC

* Creative briefs

* Reference ads

* Examples of previous winning creatives

* Clear feedback and direction

* Consistent work for the right editor



### Important



We are **not looking for someone whose main focus is making videos look cinematic or pretty.**



These are **performance ads.**



Every editing decision should serve a purpose:



**Hook attention ? maintain retention ? communicate the message ? drive action.**



You should understand how to use pacing, visuals, B-roll, captions, pattern interrupts, emotional moments, and sound design to make someone continue watching.



Most videos will range from approximately **30 seconds to 2 minutes**, although some VSL-style creatives may be longer.



### Long-Term Opportunity



We want to build a relationship with **one or more reliable editors who can become a core part of our creative team.**



If you consistently:



* Deliver quality work

* Hit deadlines

* Communicate well

* Learn from feedback

* Understand direct-response creative

* Help us improve creative output



…there will be **consistent ongoing work and room for greater responsibility as we grow.**

title: Online Course Creator & Development Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced Online Course Creator & Production Manager to help us develop and launch an online course about Airbnb, short-term rentals, rent-to-rent and property management.



We have a partial course outline and initial ideas for the course. We are looking for someone who can help us develop the remaining structure, identify any gaps, and turn our ideas and knowledge into a complete, professional online course.



Responsibilities include:

Helping develop and complete the course structure from our partial outline

Reviewing our existing ideas and suggesting improvements

Identifying missing topics, gaps and areas for improvement

Developing individual lessons, scripts, activities and resources

Creating worksheets, checklists and templates

Helping plan the filming process and creating filming briefs

Providing feedback on course content and the student learning experience

Coordinating with the video editor and other freelancers

Uploading and organising finished videos and resources on our course platform

Building and organising the final modules and lessons

Testing the course before launch

Helping manage the course development process and deadlines



We are looking for someone who can think critically and provide their own ideas. We want someone who can confidently tell us if a lesson should be moved, a topic needs to be split into multiple lessons, or important information is missing from the course.



Requirements:

Previous experience creating or developing online courses

Experience with at least one online course platform

Strong written and spoken English

Excellent organisation and attention to detail

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

Comfortable giving constructive feedback and suggesting improvements



Bonus: Experience with Airbnb, property, short-term rentals, Canva, Notion, video production or course launches.



To apply, please answer:

Tell us about your experience creating or developing online courses.

What online course platforms have you worked with?

Have you ever helped take a course from an initial idea or outline to a finished product? Please explain.

title: Outbound Sales & Lead Associate
description:
We are seeking a motivated and professional Commercial Cleaning Outbound Sales & Lead Associate to generate new business opportunities for our commercial cleaning services. This position will focus primarily on making outbound calls to businesses from provided lead lists to identify companies that have current or upcoming commercial cleaning needs.



The ideal candidate is comfortable speaking with business owners, office managers, facility managers, property managers, and other decision-makers. The primary goal is not necessarily to close the sale on the initial call, but to identify qualified prospects, gather information about their cleaning needs, and schedule opportunities for the sales team to follow up and provide a proposal or walkthrough.



Key Responsibilities -



- Make a high volume of professional outbound calls to businesses using a provided lead lists.

- Identify the appropriate decision-maker for commercial cleaning services.

- Introduce the company and explain our commercial cleaning services in a professional and compelling manner.

- Determine whether the business currently uses a cleaning company and identify potential opportunities.

- Identify businesses that are dissatisfied with their current cleaning provider or may be seeking a new provider.

- Identify upcoming opportunities, including new locations, renovations, office moves, or expiring cleaning contracts.

- Obtain accurate contact information for decision-makers.

- Schedule appointments, facility walkthroughs, or follow-up calls for qualified opportunities.

- Follow up with prospects when appropriate.

- Maintain a professional, courteous, and persistent approach when dealing with prospects.

- Meet established daily and weekly outbound call and lead-generation goals.



Qualifications -



- Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, inside sales, lead generation, or business development is preferred.

- Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

- Comfortable making frequent outbound calls and speaking with business professionals.

- Ability to confidently ask questions and identify customer needs.

- Professional, positive, and persistent attitude.

- Organized and able to accurately document calls and prospect information.

- Basic computer skills for notes on lead generations.

- Commercial cleaning, janitorial, facilities management, or B2B sales experience is a plus but not required.



Performance Expectations - 

Success in this position will be measured primarily by:



Outbound calls completed.

Decision-makers reached.

Qualified commercial cleaning opportunities identified.

Appointments or walkthroughs scheduled.

Accurate and complete lead documentation.

Follow-up activity and overall quality of leads generated.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who isn't afraid to pick up the phone, can handle rejection professionally, and enjoys creating opportunities from cold leads. They should be persistent without being pushy and able to quickly determine whether a business represents a legitimate opportunity for commercial cleaning services.



Primary Objective:

Generate a consistent pipeline of qualified commercial cleaning leads and appointments that can be pursued by the company's sales team.

title: Email Strategist
description:
Momentum Marketing is a done-for-you
 and SMS retention agency for DTC ecommerce brands. We run the full retention engine end-to-end inside Klaviyo, and we back our work with a revenue attribution guarantee. We are direct, numbers-led, and allergic to agency fluff. Our clients pay us to protect their margin while acquisition costs climb, and every
 we send has to earn its place in the inbox.



We are growing, and we are hiring a copywriter who can own the copy for an entire pod of brands.



The Role



You will be the copywriter inside a pod. Each pod manages 5 to 7 brands depending on capacity and pod size, and you own all copy across every flow and campaign for the brands in your pod.



This is not a "write a few
s a week" role. You are the retention copy engine for your pod, and the pod's revenue numbers depend on your output.



What you will do

Build the campaign calendar every single month for each brand in your pod. This is a core, non-negotiable deliverable, not an occasional task.

Write all campaign copy for your pod's brands, mapped to the monthly calendar.

Write all flow copy — Welcome, Abandoned Checkout, Abandoned Cart, Browse Abandon, Site Abandon, Post-Purchase, Winback, and Sunset. Post-purchase is where we expect you to be exceptional.

Structure flows strategically inside Klaviyo — you know how to set up the right conditional splits, and how to split based on buyer intent and dollar value. You do not just write copy; you know where each
 sits and why.

Complete all assigned work daily. The role does not run on fixed hours beyond the 10:00 AM daily start, but every task and duty assigned to you must be completed. Output is the measure, not hours logged.

Prerequisite: Supplement Brand Experience (Non-Negotiable)



You must have proven, demonstrable success writing for 7 to 8 figure supplement brands. This is a hard prerequisite, not a preference.



That means you understand supplement buyer psychology at a working level:



Why supplement customers buy, why they lapse, and what actually reactivates them

How to sell repeat purchase and subscription without sounding desperate

How to handle claims, ingredients, and benefits persuasively and responsibly

How to write post-purchase sequences that turn a first order into a second and third



You will be asked to show proof of work. Portfolio pieces from 7-8 figure supplement brands with real performance data (open rates, click rates, revenue attributed). If you cannot show this, please do not apply.



Manual Copywriting Only — No AI



All copy must be written by you, manually. We will know if it is written by AI.



AI copy has a tell: it cannot think, it cannot adapt to a specific region's culture and language, and it cannot make the creative word choices that make an
 feel like it was written by a human who actually understands the customer. We need a writer who can flex tone, reference culture, and choose words that land with a specific audience in a specific market.

Learner's mindset. There is always something you can learn. We expect you to want feedback and act on it.

Hunger. We want ambitious people who want to excel, not people looking to coast.

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based law firm seeking an Executive Administrative Assistant to provide dependable, high-level administrative support to the firm's day-to-day operations. This is a part-time position to start, with the potential for expanded hours, responsibilities, and a full-time role as the firm's needs grow.



The position is Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time. We are looking for someone who is interested in developing a long-term relationship with the firm and becoming someone we can rely on to keep things organized and moving forward.



This role requires more than simply completing a checklist of assigned tasks. The successful candidate will be able to manage competing priorities, notice details that others may overlook, communicate clearly and professionally, and use good judgment when handling administrative matters. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through, and can increasingly work independently as they become familiar with the firm.



About the Role



The Executive Administrative Assistant will work closely with the firm's leadership and assist with a variety of administrative, organizational, and operational matters. The position will involve handling both recurring responsibilities and one-off projects, so flexibility and a willingness to learn are important.



Depending on experience and the firm's needs, responsibilities may include:



- Managing and organizing calendars, meetings, and appointments

- Preparing, editing, and formatting correspondence, documents, and other materials

- Drafting routine
s and communications based on instructions or established templates

- Maintaining well-organized electronic files and client-related folders

- Managing documents and information within Google Drive and other cloud-based systems

- Preparing forms, applications, and other administrative materials

- Maintaining spreadsheets, databases, trackers, and internal records

- Reviewing documents for accuracy, completeness, formatting, and consistency

- Conducting internet research and organizing information into useful summaries

- Assisting with client onboarding and administrative follow-up

- Monitoring deadlines, follow-ups, and outstanding administrative items

- Coordinating with vendors, service providers, and other third parties as needed

- Assisting with firm projects, systems, and process improvements

- Following and helping maintain the firm's Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

- Learning new software, systems, and processes as needed

- Providing general administrative support to firm leadership

- Handling other projects and responsibilities as they arise



As you become more familiar with the firm and our operations, we expect the successful candidate to take on greater responsibility and become increasingly proactive in identifying ways to improve efficiency and organization.



What We Are Looking For



The right person will be:



- Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable and consistent

- Comfortable managing multiple priorities

- A strong written and verbal communicator in English

- Professional and courteous in all communications

- Able to work independently while knowing when to ask questions

- Comfortable handling confidential and sensitive information

- Proactive rather than waiting to be told what needs to be done

- Willing to learn unfamiliar systems and processes

- Someone who takes ownership of their work and follows tasks through to completion

- Comfortable receiving feedback and continually improving their work



Prior experience as an executive assistant, legal assistant, administrative assistant, or in another professional services environment is preferred. Law firm experience is not required, and we are willing to train someone who demonstrates the organizational ability, professionalism, and work ethic we are looking for.



Hours



- Must be available Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time

- Guaranteed 20 hours per week

- Additional hours may become available as the firm's needs develop

- Applicants must be able to consistently work during the stated Eastern Time hours



We are specifically seeking someone interested in a long-term position, rather than someone looking for a short-term or temporary opportunity.



How to Apply



Please follow all of the application instructions below. Attention to detail is an important part of this position, so failure to follow the instructions may result in your application not being considered.



Please include:



- A brief introduction explaining your interest in the position and what makes you well suited for an executive administrative role.

- A summary of your previous administrative, executive assistant, legal, customer service, or professional services experience.

- Your current resume.

- A link to a 2–3 minute introductory video telling us about yourself, your professional background, and why you are interested in working with our firm.

- Your expected hourly rate in USD.

- Your availability, including confirmation that you can work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time.

- At least five (5) apply points. Applications submitted with fewer than five apply points will not be considered.

- The word DIVISION in the subject line of your application.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted and integral member of our team. If you are highly organized, dependable, comfortable taking initiative, and enjoy supporting a professional environment where no two days are exactly the same, we encourage you to apply.

* Dealing with trolls and disruptive users.

* Monitoring conversations for suspicious or problematic activity.

* Enforcing community rules consistently.

* Escalating serious issues to the team.

* Helping maintain a welcoming and safe environment for thousands of users.



Customer Support



* Answering user questions.

* Helping users understand and use the app.

* Solving basic issues.

* Responding to community requests.

* Escalating more complex issues when necessary.



Additional Virtual Assistant Tasks



When the community is quiet and there are no urgent moderation issues, you will help us with other day-to-day tasks.



This can include:



* Researching TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creators.

* Finding potential creators and influencers in the music/concert space.

* Researching content ideas and trends.

* Finding interesting video concepts for our social media accounts.

* Helping organize information and daily tasks.

* Conducting online research.

* Supporting the team with various operational tasks.



The goal is to have someone who can proactively help us wherever needed, rather than someone who only waits for moderation issues to appear.



What We're Looking For



* Fluent or highly comfortable in English.

* Very comfortable with social media and online communities.

* Experienced with Discord moderation, community management, customer support, or virtual assistance.

* Comfortable dealing with difficult users and enforcing rules.

* Able to recognize scams, spam, trolling, and suspicious behavior.

* Highly responsive and reliable.

* Organized and detail-oriented.

* Proactive and independent.

* Interested in music, concerts, social media, and online communities.

* Comfortable working with tools such as Discord, Instagram, TikTok, Google Sheets, etc.



Previous Community Experience Is a Big Plus



Experience managing or moderating a Discord server,
 group, Reddit community, social media account, or similar online community is highly appreciated.



You should understand how online communities work and be comfortable making decisions when moderation is required.



Why Join Us?



* Long-term position — we're looking for someone to stay with us for the long run.

* Opportunity to work with a fast-growing international community.

* Several thousand users already on the platform, with continued growth.

* Strong presence across social media.

* Work directly with the founders and core team.

* Variety of responsibilities — moderation, customer support, research, content, and operations.

* Potential to take on more responsibility as the company grows.

* Opportunity to become a key member of the team rather than simply working on a short-term project.



The Ideal Candidate



We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys being online, understands how communities work, and is naturally curious.



Someone who sees a problem and takes care of it without always needing to be told what to do.



You will essentially become a daily extension of our team, helping us keep the community safe, supporting our users, researching opportunities, and contributing to the growth of the business.



How to Apply



Please send us:



* A short introduction about yourself.

* Your previous experience with community management, moderation, customer support, or virtual assistance.

* Any online communities or Discord servers you have previously managed or moderated.

* Your availability and preferred working hours.

* Your expected salary/rate.

* Why you think you would be a good fit for this long-term position.
