title: Property Operations Lead - Remote
description:
Location: Remote 

Core Availability: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–6:00pm Eastern Time (USA) 

Compensation: $2,000 per month 



SteelSafe Self Storage operates storage properties across the United States. Customers rent individual storage units and shipping containers from us to store their belongings, business inventory, equipment, and other items. 



Our properties are managed remotely. When a customer moves out, we need to quickly inspect, clean, repair, and prepare that storage unit so the next customer can rent it. 



We’re hiring a Property Operations Lead to manage that process remotely. Your main goal is simple: keep our properties Rent-Ready and get units back on the market fast. 



What you get: 

A clear scoreboard and a role that matters. 

Direct access to leadership and fast decisions. 

A system-driven operation (we run on Asana). 

Performance bonus opportunity tied to ops execution. 

High trust and real autonomy. 

Real authority. You are not here to pass problems to someone else. You have the authority to solve them and improve the systems behind them. 

Freedom earned through results. We care about outcomes, not looking busy. Own the result, get the job done, then build systems so the job demands less of you tomorrow. 



What you’ll do: 

Manage the entire unit turnover process: after a customer moves out, make sure the unit is inspected, cleaned, repaired if needed, and ready for the next customer to rent. 

Manage local Boots-On-The-Ground (BOTG) contractors who physically inspect, clean, repair, and maintain our properties. 

Assign maintenance and repair jobs, follow up until they are completed, and verify the finished work using photos or videos. 

Keep sites customer-ready: gates, locks, cameras, lighting, cleanliness, and curb appeal meet SteelSafe standards. 

Handle property projects end‑to‑end (example: order a sign, coordinate install, confirm with proof). 



What you own (outcomes): 

Median Time‑to‑Rent‑Ready (TTRR) after move‑out. 

Rent‑Ready Unit % stays high and trending up. 

Work orders are dispatched quickly, completed quickly, and closed with proof. 

BOTG tasks are completed on time with proof, and contractor records and payments stay current. 

Publish a weekly scorecard that identifies misses, drives action, and holds owners accountable. 



The authority and tools you’ll have: 

You have the authority to improve the operation: turn workflows, proof standards, BOTG and vendor performance, inspection schedules, and the systems used to keep properties Rent-Ready. 

Asana as the operating system (tasks, checklists, proof). 



This role is a fit if you: 

Own the result, not the clock. You do what it takes when the operation needs you, then improve the system so the same result takes less time, less chasing, and less effort next time. 

Work independently, make good decisions, and move fast.  

Communicate early when deadlines, quality, or outcomes are at risk.   

Manage a small team, vendors, and contractors with confidence.  

Keep multiple properties and projects organized without losing details.  

Think in terms of ownership, deadlines, checklists, and proof of completion.  

Maintain high standards for cleanliness, safety, security, and customer experience. 

Find and fix root causes, not just recurring symptoms.  

Turn messy operations into reliable, repeatable systems.  

Are a doer who takes pride in measurable results, not activity.

title: Video & Audio Editor (Remote, Ad-Hoc Contract)
description:
Orange & Gray helps independent hearing care (audiology) practices across North America compete against the big retail chains. We build websites, run campaigns, and produce content for over 80 member practices. We're a small, remote team (under 20 people) and we move fast.



THE JOB,

One week you're cleaning up a shaky phone-recorded patient testimonial so it sounds and looks professional. The next week you're building a full campaign video with branded intros, motion graphics, and a proper storyline. Some weeks it's a 30-minute audio clean-up job. Other weeks it's a multi-day production. We need someone who can flex between both without dropping quality on either.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Video Editing

- Cleaning up member-shot footage (often smartphone quality) into polished, on-brand videos: testimonials, practice tours, educational content, promos

- Colour correction, trimming, basic audio fixes for quick-turnaround jobs

- Full productions when briefed: branded intros/outros, motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, CTA overlays

- Keeping every edit matching the specific member's brand (logo, colours, fonts - every client is different)

- Exporting/optimising for YouTube,
, Instagram,
, and web embeds



Audio Editing

- Cleaning noisy recordings: removing background noise, levelling volume, improving clarity

- Editing podcast episodes and interviews into publish-ready audio

- Adding branded intros/outros to audio content



YouTube & Vimeo Management

- Uploading and managing videos across member channels: titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, playlists, end screens

- Managing Vimeo settings: privacy, embed configs

- Keeping metadata/branding consistent per member

- Flagging any channel issues or comments needing attention



Bigger Projects (when they come up)

- Full campaign videos, event coverage edits, multi-asset production briefs

- Giving accurate time estimates so we can plan capacity

- Delivering work members are proud to put on their own websites and socials



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Solid video editing chops: you can turn rough, imperfect footage into something premium-looking, and you can show us examples

- Audio editing skills: noise removal, levelling, podcast/interview editing

- Comfortable with Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve (or similar) for video; Audacity, Adobe Audition (or similar) for audio

- Some motion graphics ability: branded intros, lower thirds, overlays (After Effects is a bonus, not required)

- Know your way around YouTube and Vimeo channel management

- Can juggle multiple client brands without mixing up styles

- Comfortable going from a 20-minute quick clean-up to a multi-day production in the same week

- Reliable: when a deadline is agreed, it's hit, every time

- Own equipment and a stable internet connection (non-negotiable, we can't work around outages)

- Able to overlap enough with North American/UK working hours for briefs and feedback (doesn't need to be full shift, just responsive)



Nice to have (not required):

- Experience editing healthcare or professional services content

- Comfortable working with non-professional/user-generated footage

- Experience with US-based clients

- Subtitling/accessibility experience (captions, SRT files, etc.)

- Knowledge of current social video formats/trends



PAY & STRUCTURE

Rate depends on experience and project complexity. Monthly invoicing against tracked hours. Work volume varies, some months are quiet, some are busy. This is ongoing, ad-hoc work, not a fixed-hours contract. Open to solo freelancers or small agencies/teams who can flex between quick edits and larger productions.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. A showreel or portfolio showing your range: quick clean-ups AND more polished productions

2. A sample of your audio editing work: cleaned-up podcast, interview, or similar

3. A short intro covering how you typically work, your availability/hours you can commit per week, and your rate expectations



Bonus points if you include a before-and-after of raw footage you've transformed, or a quick walkthrough of your editing process.



Only applications with actual work samples will be considered, please don't apply without a portfolio link.

title: AI Product Builder / Full-Stack Developer – Claude Code + API Integration

 notifications

REST API integrations

Databases

Authentication

Payment integrations

SaaS dashboards

Credit / balance systems

Git / GitHub

Deployment

Debugging

Experience with SaaS products, marketplaces, dashboards or API-driven products is a major advantage.



What We Value



We are looking for someone who is:



Fast

Reliable

Cost-conscious

Independent

Curious

Highly motivated

Comfortable learning new tools

Able to solve problems without waiting for detailed instructions

Interested in staying with the project long-term

First Project

API/provider access

Branding direction

Pricing concept

Feature priorities

Examples of competitor platforms for UX inspiration

Long-Term Opportunity

As the platform grows, there will be opportunities to:

Improve automation

Help with growth experiments

Build affiliate systems

Develop new internal tools

title: Guest Communication & Operations Assistant – Vacation Rentals | Remote
description:
U.S.-based vacation rental management company is looking for highly responsive, detail-oriented remote team members to help monitor guest communication and daily operations.



This role is not just answering messages. You will help make sure the entire guest experience runs smoothly from booking through checkout.



Schedule

• Coverage is needed approximately 6:00–7:00 AM through 12:00 AM U.S. Central Time

• Team members will be assigned to either a morning/day shift or afternoon/evening shift

• Must be available weekdays and weekends

• Please understand that these hours will fall during evening/overnight hours in the Philippines

• You must be fully available and attentive during your assigned shift



Guest Communication & Monitoring

• Monitor guest communication across Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, Google Vacation Rentals, OwnerRez, and other systems

• Monitor HostBuddy, our AI guest communication system, and step in whenever human assistance is needed

• Maintain a guest response time of approximately 1–2 minutes. NO EXCEPTIONS!

• Answer guest questions and troubleshoot issues quickly

• Ensure scheduled guest messages are sent correctly and on time

• Review upcoming reservations for accuracy

• Verify door codes, check-in details, and arrival information

• Make sure the guest check-in and checkout process is running smoothly

• Catch and correct issues before they affect the guest whenever possible



Reservations & Operations

• Modify reservations

• Extend stays

• Add charges when needed

• Coordinate with cleaners, maintenance, and vendors

• Follow issues through to resolution

• Learn each property and its details so you can confidently answer guest questions

• Update property information, procedures, and notes in Notion

• Complete administrative and operational tasks during quieter periods

• Be willing to take on additional responsibilities as the role grows



Requirements

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Very fast and reliable internet

• Reliable computer

• Backup internet or connectivity strongly preferred

• Quiet, distraction-free workspace

• Ability to remain actively engaged throughout your shift

• Extremely responsive — guest messages cannot sit unanswered while you are working

• Strong customer service and problem-solving skills

• Organized, dependable, and detail-oriented

• Able to multitask and prioritize urgent situations

• Comfortable learning multiple software platforms

• Able to work independently and take initiative

• Comfortable learning a large amount of property-specific information



Experience with vacation rentals, Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, hospitality, reservations, or customer service is preferred.



Experience with OwnerRez, HostBuddy, Notion, Asana, SuiteOp, or similar platforms is a plus.



To Apply



 
 with:



• Your resume

• Your location in the Philippines

• Your availability

• Whether you prefer the morning/day shift, afternoon/evening shift, or either

• Your relevant experience

• Include the code word Goldfish in the subject line

• A 3–5 minute VIDEO answering both questions below



VIDEO QUESTIONS



Tell us about yourself.

Briefly introduce yourself, tell us about your relevant experience, and explain why you think you would be a good fit for this role.

Guest Scenario

title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer
description:
AI Scaling is hiring a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer to build the operating system used by AI implementation agencies.

This is a hands-on role in a large production TypeScript codebase. You should be comfortable moving between React interfaces, data hooks, Postgres-backed models, API boundaries, and integration behavior. You do not need prior experience with every library we use, but you must be able to reason about an existing system before changing it.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Trace behavior across page components, hooks, Edge Functions, database state, and external providers.

• Write focused unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using Vitest, Testing Library, and Playwright.

• Review existing code carefully, preserve workspace isolation, and avoid regressions in connected workflows.

• Investigate production issues using evidence from source, data, provider responses, and rendered behavior.

• You understand authentication, authorization, multi-tenancy, and row-level access controls.

• You have strong product judgment and can make complex workflows understandable without oversimplifying them.

• You write and maintain automated tests and can explain what should be tested at each layer.

• You communicate clearly in written English, work independently, and surface uncertainty early.

Helpful experience includes Supabase, Deno or serverless functions, no-code or workflow builders, CRM products, AI-assisted software, provider integrations, accessibility, and large TypeScript applications.



STRUCTURE

AI Scaling OS connects CRM, campaigns,
, calendars, meetings, documents, automations, and AI agents. The hard part is not calling individual APIs. It is keeping provider truth, database truth, user-visible state, and tenant boundaries aligned when events arrive late, repeat, fail, or disagree.

• Work with Postgres constraints, indexes, transactions, row-level security, and data migrations.

• Integrate systems such as
, calendars, CRM, enrichment, communications, meeting intelligence, and AI runtimes.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Reels / TikTok / Shorts)
description:
About the Role



We're a boutique branding studio based in the Netherlands. We work at the intersection of brand identity, strategy, and design execution, and everything we put out, including our short-form video, is expected to feel as considered as the brands we build.



We're looking for a skilled short-form video editor to join us on a gig basis, with a clear path toward part-time and eventually full-time collaboration for the right person. You'll receive a brief, brand deliverables, and a kick-off call, then own the edit from start to finish. Part of the work involves editing AI-generated footage (e.g. Kling, Runway) into finished, brand-grade reels, so comfort working with generated clips, and the imperfections that come with them, is essential.



This is not an entry-level role, and it is NOT for someone who just started editing and is looking to grow into the work. We need someone who has already done this at a high level, repeatedly, and can prove it with published work.



What You'll Do



- Receive project briefs via online meeting and written documentation, then independently own full short-form edits

- Cut vertical (9:16) reels for a range of brand contexts, including narrative pieces, product content, studio content, and more

- Design and animate captions and titles in the brand's typeface, kinetic typography that looks intentional rather than default auto-caption

- Handle sound design: choose and cut music, sync cuts to the beat, and time drops and hits so the edit lands emotionally

- Colour grade and unify footage from mixed sources, including AI-generated clips, into one cohesive look

- Work with AI-generated source clips: select the cleanest usable frames, cut around artefacts, and know when a clip needs regenerating

- Deliver organised, export-ready files to platform spec, and help us build reusable templates as the format matures



What This Role Is Not



This is not a role for a generalist or long-form editor. Wedding, vlog, corporate, and talking-head YouTube editing is a different craft, and we're specifically after short-form, brand-led vertical work.



It's not for CapCut-and-auto-captions editors. We care about custom, on-brand typography and real sound design, not templated defaults.



And it's not for someone who needs constant hand-holding. You receive the brief, ask the right questions upfront, and deliver, with proactive communication if questions come up.



What We're Looking For



Required:



- A strong portfolio of published short-form vertical work (Reels / TikTok / Shorts) that shows real craft. Brand or product content preferred, not personal vlogs. We will be looking at it critically

- Expert-level in either After Effects or Premiere Pro, and strong in the other. After Effects capability matters, because our caption and title work lives there

- Motion graphics and kinetic typography. You can animate text in a brand typeface and make it feel designed

- Genuine sound-design instinct. Cutting music to the beat and making a drop land is non-negotiable, it's where a good reel becomes a great one

- Colour grading, the ability to take mismatched clips and unify them into a single, cohesive look

- Comfortable editing AI-generated footage and working around its quirks

- Reliable communication in English, written and spoken

- Able to work independently from a brief with minimal back-and-forth



Nice to have:



- Hands-on experience with AI video tools (Kling, Runway, or similar)

- A templated, systematic way of working. You document your process, because we intend to make our best formats repeatable

- Familiarity with Figma and working from brand deliverables

- Prior agency or brand content experience



How We Work Together



Every project starts with a briefing call where we walk you through the use case, goals, and brand direction. After the call, we provide written documentation and all relevant brand deliverables. From there, you own the edit. We expect proactive communication if questions come up. No silence until delivery.



Compensation



This starts as a gig engagement, paid hourly, based on experience and portfolio. We pay well for the right person. Strong collaborators will have the opportunity to move into a structured part-time role, and eventually a full-time position as the relationship grows.



How to Apply



Send us:



- Your portfolio, links to published, live short-form work only. No unlisted mockups or screenshots of editor views. We want to see what you've actually shipped

- A short introduction: your background, the types of projects you've worked on, the tools you're expert in, and your hourly rate expectation



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a paid test project, one full reel edited from a real brief, before we move forward. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: Looking for a killer Video Editor (Long-term, CapCut/Descript, Sales-focused)
description:
I’m looking to bring on a video editor for a long-term role. But honestly, I don't just need someone who knows how to trim clips and slap on some trendy subtitles. I need someone who understands how videos actually sell.



As a video editor myself, I know exactly what goes into making high-performing content. The videos you edit are going to be a critical part of the marketing process. If you know what makes a strong hook and how to keep a viewer's attention, we’re going to get along great.



What you’ll actually be doing:



Taking raw, long-form footage and cutting out all the dead air so it flows perfectly and smoothly.



Finding the absolute best 3-5 seconds of that long-form video and turning it into a punchy, high-converting hook.



Using CapCut and Descript heavily. You need to be fast and comfortable in these tools.



Adding clean motion graphics. I don't want crazy effects just for the sake of it, your graphics should emphasize the core message.



Why work with me?

This isn't a one-off project. This is a long-term gig. As our content volume scales up, there is a ton of room for you to grow in experience, improve your skills, and take on a bigger role in the editing workflow.



How to apply (Read carefully):

I get a lot of copy-pasted spam applications, so to prove you actually read this post, please put the word "Blueberry" at the very beginning of your
 subject line. If I don't see that word, I'll delete the application without opening it.



Send your application directly to 
 and include the following (Applicants who sent an incomplete requirements will automatically be rejected):



1. A quick sentence or two on why you want a long-term role and how you think about "pacing" in a sales video.



2. Links to 1 or 2 long-form videos you've edited (so I can see your smooth cuts).



3. Links to 2 or 3 short-form videos you've edited (so I can see your hooks and motion graphics).



4. Your current comfort level with CapCut and Descript.



Looking forward to seeing your work! We will be doing a quick test task for the top few applicants to make sure our workflows click.

title: Character Illustrator-Animator | AI Visual Producer
description:
Prismiera is building an identity-forward jewelry/e-com brand through animated AI series' and worldbuilding. We're hiring a remote creative-production specialist for character design, animation, and charm.



We're looking for someone who can draw by hand as a baseline indicator for art fundamentals; whose work shows strong character taste — expression, gesture, emotional acting, aesthetic charm, and animation or storytelling instincts. AI tool experience is a plus, not a requirement. We can train the AI pipeline relatively quickly, but the artistic talent and execution ceiling we're looking for is not something we can teach. Therefore,



**We're especially interested in people who've built and sustained their own creative work — a channel, a webcomic, indie projects, a personal art practice, or deployed content for someone else with sustained self-directed shipping and creative exploration and ownership. If your background is more traditional (studio, agency, client work), that's fine too — we'll evaluate on the work itself.**



AI has collapsed the creative space into taste, artistic eye, experimentation, and speed of execution. So we're looking for execution discipline — you finish work, you iterate cleanly, you ship completed videos autonomously under shifting artistic demand, and you adapt quickly across different styles and mediums.



What you'll do



Steering, selecting, rejecting, refining, and sequencing AI-generated visuals so they match our shifting style demands, emotional tone, and character identity.



- Visual-audio judgment and strict curation of AI output

- Refine expressive character stills using AI tools, reference pools

- Generate motion video from curated stills using AI video tools (Seedance2, Kling — guidance provided)

- Time clips of varying styles to narration, and deliver finished 20–60 second character-led videos

- Curate ElevenLabs voiceover and attitude (guidance provided)

- Sequence and time motion clips against narration

- Keep recurring characters consistent across many pieces

- Help build reference systems and visual judgment language over time

- Document what worked, what failed, and why — so the system improves



Style direction

Character work with high emotional expressiveness — diverse emotional and stylistic grammar from shoujo/josei to shonen/seinen to other virality-native illustrated character storytelling styles. Work should feel alive and artist-directed, not randomly generated (your art has an opinionated, taste driven direction, not general). You can play across emotional registers — dramatic, comedic, melancholic, playful, action-driven.



We provide SOPs on content format and scripting, but having your own working sense of what makes content land + general virality sense, will make the process smoother.



You might be a fit if you

- Have visual substrate in character work — illustration, comics, animation, storyboards, VTuber assets, visual novels, AI character work, or another medium where expression and character consistency matter

- Can diagnose why a character feels off

- Sustain self-directed creative output

- Are curious about AI image and motion tools, even if you haven't used them extensively yet

- Can time visual beats to narration rhythm

- Communicate clearly and work well async



AI-assisted portfolios are welcome — we'll evaluate your execution.



Compensation

$800–$1,100 USD/month full-time depending on portfolio and trial performance. Higher long-term compensation available for candidates with autonomous judgment as we expand our worldbuilding and brand. We're looking for a long-term creative partner.



Trial period prior to confirmed engagement. Tool access and AI tool credits provided.



How to apply

Send:



Portfolio link — your best work. Ideally work you've deployed into your own channels or someone else's, or any creative project you've sustained over time, showcasing self-directed creative ownership.



Character or emotional pieces, showcasing your expressive range, charming aesthetic execution, etc.

Motion or sequence sample if available (animatic, short edit, Live2D/VTuber motion, AI motion, storyboard sequence, AE edits, etc)



Use at least 7 apply points.



Shortlisted candidates move into a paid two-week trial that may convert to a confirmed monthly retainer.

title: Operations Support Specialist - Dispatch & Logistics (US Trucking Company)
description:
Moscoso Express is a 20+ year trucking company in the United States specializing in expedited and air freight. We move time-sensitive shipments across the Midwest, where clear communication, accuracy, urgency, and follow-through are essential.



We are hiring 4 Operations Support Specialists. This is a fast-paced operations role involving dispatch coordination, customer communication, shipment monitoring, data accuracy, and problem-solving. You will help coordinate drivers, customers, internal team members, and shipment details to keep freight moving on time.



Fluent spoken English is required. You will be speaking with American drivers and customers every day.



The role includes:

- Coordinating daily freight movements to help shipments stay on schedule

- Communicating professionally with drivers, customers, and internal team members

- Monitoring loads and providing timely status updates

- Checking shipment details, GPS/location information, and order notes

- Helping resolve delays, weather issues, equipment issues, schedule changes, or pickup/delivery exceptions

- Keeping accurate records of shipment updates, order details, and key communications

- Working across
, spreadsheets, GPS tracking platforms, client portals, and dispatch systems

- Escalating issues when needed with clear details and recommended next steps



We are looking for someone who is:

- Professional, respectful, and clear when communicating with drivers, customers, and team members

- Organized and dependable in a fast-moving environment

- Detail-oriented and accurate with order information, shipment updates, and documentation

- Comfortable working across
, spreadsheets, GPS tracking, client portals, and dispatch systems

- Able to follow SOPs, checklists, and company procedures

- Proactive while staying aligned with company processes

- Coachable and willing to learn Moscoso Express methods

- Able to follow up until an issue is resolved



Important expectations:

This is not a passive remote admin role. During your shift, you are expected to actively monitor shipments, respond quickly, follow up with drivers, update customers, document activity, and escalate issues when needed.



This role requires balanced judgment. We do not want someone who waits for every instruction, and we do not want someone who acts without understanding the company process. The right person is proactive, but aligned; independent, but coachable; and fast, but accurate.



Working hours:

Training runs on a fixed schedule in US Central Time. Your regular schedule is assigned during training.

- Initial training: 2 weeks, 6:00 AM - 2:00 PM US Central Time, Monday to Friday. In Philippine time this is currently 7:00 PM - 3:00 AM, Monday night through Saturday morning.

- Ongoing training and coaching continue through your first 3 months, alongside your regular shift.

- After initial training: we operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, so regular schedules vary and may include weekend hours. Your shift is set with you during training.



Please read this carefully before applying:

- All schedules are set in US Central Time, so your Philippine local hours and days will not match ours. A US daytime shift falls overnight in the Philippines, and a US evening shift falls during Philippine daytime.

- The 2 weeks of initial training are overnight in the Philippines.

- Philippine times shift one hour later when US daylight saving time ends in November.



Please only apply if you can commit to the full 2 weeks of initial training and are able to work a varying schedule, including possible weekend hours, afterward.



Working arrangement and pay:

- The rate for this role is $9 - $11 USD per hour, based on your experience. At 40 hours per week, that is about $1,560 - $1,900 USD per month.

- This is an independent contractor position, not employment. You are responsible for your own taxes and government contributions in the Philippines.

- Training is also a trial period, for you as much as for us. It is a chance for both sides to see whether the role and the schedule are a good fit.

- During this period we are not able to promise work for any set length of time, and either side may d
 at any point that it is not the right match.

- We will be straightforward with you about how things are going, and we hope you will be just as open with us. If it is working well, we would very much like you to stay with us long term.

- Pay is sent twice a month.

- We use TimeProof for time tracking. You install the free TimeProof app from OnlineJobs.ph and sign in with your OnlineJobs.ph account. It records your working time and takes periodic screenshots of your screen while you are on shift. Your pay is based on this record. Please only apply if you are comfortable working with screenshot-based time tracking.



Helpful experience:

Dispatch, logistics, trucking, freight, customer service, data entry, administrative support, or operations support. Familiarity with TMS systems, GPS tracking software, spreadsheets,
, or client portals is also helpful.



Remote work requirements:

- Reliable internet access

- Suitable quiet workspace for remote work

- Working computer setup

- Ability to work on a computer throughout the shift

- Two or more monitors



How to apply:

Record a 1-2 minute video introducing yourself and briefly explaining why your professionalism, communication skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability would make you a good fit for this role. Send us the link to your video in your reply here. You can use any of these:

- Loom (
) - free, records you and your screen right in the browser, gives you a link instantly

- YouTube - upload and set the video to "Unlisted"

- Google Drive - upload and set sharing to "Anyone with the link"



Please open your link in a private/incognito window first to confirm it plays for someone outside your account. Applications without a working video link will not be reviewed.

title: Nightlife Short-Form Video Editor
description:
I'm looking for a reliable, detail-oriented short-form video editor to help me create content for my nightlife event brand's social media. This is an ongoing role with consistent daily work.



You'll be receiving raw footage from me (event footage, phone/camera clips, and skit-style content shot by my team), and your job will be to turn it into polished, high-energy short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok. I'll train you and give you direction across different content styles so you can lock in the system quickly — you don't need prior nightlife experience, you need to be able to learn my process and execute it consistently.



What You'll Be Doing

Receive raw footage via Google Drive and edit it into vertical short-form video across a few distinct styles depending on the video's purpose:



Hook/discovery content — fast-cut, mystery or exclusivity-driven, direct-to-camera, text-reveal overlays. Built to stop the scroll in the first second.

Story/personality content — skits and theme-driven pieces that build out the brand's world and personality, not just plain event promo.

Recap/proof content — high-energy event recaps that make the viewer feel like they missed something. Crowd-POV, not stage-POV.

Momentum/hype content — post-event clips that carry energy into the next event and build anticipation.



I'll tell you which style a given video needs and give feedback as we go — expect a real training/feedback loop, especially in the first few weeks.



Other responsibilities:

Add text overlays, captions, pacing cuts, and trending audio sync where it fits the style

Deliver finished videos to a provided Google Drive folder and notify me via 
 when complete

Turn around each video within 24 hours of receiving the raw footage

Handle roughly 1-2 videos per day



Requirements (Very Important)

Strong short-form video editing skills — Reels/TikTok pacing, hooks, text overlays, cuts. Any editing software is fine (CapCut, Premiere, Resolve, etc.) as long as the output is right.

Able to adjust tone and pacing across different video styles, not just one repeated template

Reliable 24-hour turnaround, every time

Comfortable receiving direction and feedback regularly, this role involves ongoing training as we build the brand's system together


 as primary communication — responsive during your working hours

Examples of short-form video editing work you've done (any niche — Reels/TikTok pacing and hooks matter more than subject matter)

Your daily/weekly availability

title: Luxury Travel Customer Operations Specialist (Remote)
description:
Position Overview



As a Luxury Travel Customer Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for managing time-sensitive VIP airport and travel services for passengers traveling through airports worldwide. The role involves coordinating complex travel arrangements, handling urgent operational requests, and ensuring flawless service delivery for high-profile and luxury travel clients.



This position carries significant operational responsibility. You will regularly handle urgent requests, last-minute travel changes, and multiple priorities simultaneously, often under strict deadlines. Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to remain calm, focused, and responsive in a fast-paced environment where quick and accurate decision-making is critical.



We are looking for a highly responsible, proactive, and dependable professional who can independently manage operational responsibilities while maintaining excellent communication with clients, suppliers, and internal teams.



Key Responsibilities



- Respond promptly to all incoming calls,
s, and messages related to pre-service and post-service requests.

- Manage new bookings, verify travel details, and ensure accurate data entry across company systems.

- Confirm that all required information is collected, verified, and communicated clearly to clients and operational partners.

- Coordinate VIP airport services and monitor requests to ensure successful execution.

- Create and send invoices, track payments, and maintain accurate client records.

- Assist clients with special travel requests, urgent changes, and last-minute operational adjustments.

- Communicate proactively with the manager on duty regarding urgent situations, service issues, complaints, or operational escalations.

- Ensure all bookings, modifications, and cancellations comply with company procedures and service deadlines.

- Promote and cross-sell additional services and return-trip assistance when appropriate.

- Maintain a high level of responsiveness and professionalism while managing multiple active cases simultaneously.



Qualifications



- Previous experience in travel, aviation, hospitality, luxury services, concierge, executive assistance, or other fast-paced customer operations is strongly preferred.

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to work across multiple systems simultaneously.

- Good knowledge of world geography, international travel, and airport operations.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

- Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple urgent requests at the same time.

- Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision.

- Access to a computer or laptop, reliable high-speed internet, and a working phone for calls.

- Ability to work flexible schedules, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and public holidays.

- Professional, calm, and composed approach when handling high-pressure situations.

title: Social Media Content & Community Manager (initial 10 hrs per week)
description:
COMPANY: 

YCM - an Australian consultancy helping construction and trade contractors prove their capability and win government and commercial work. Hours: Approximately 10 hours per week initially, with priorities agreed around that capacity. Room to grow. 



THE ROLE:

I run a specialist procurement consultancy in Australia helping construction and trade contractors prove their capability and win contracts. I have drafted a social media strategy, brand guidelines, content calendar and Canva template as the basis. What I need now is a capable person to run it week to week.



This is not a scheduling job and it is not a copy-paste job. You will draft captions, choose the right format for each idea, adapt content across Instagram, 
 and
, and manage the community. Instagram is the primary channel. You will work from my strategy and brand guide, and I will review your work before it goes live until we build trust, then you will get more independence.



I want someone who can work from an objective, not just a list of instructions. If you see a stronger way to execute an idea, I want you to say so.



The single most important thing about this role: you must never make anything up. My business is built on accuracy and evidence. You will never invent a client result, a statistic, a testimonial or a claim. If you are not sure whether something is true or approved, you ask me. Getting this wrong once is worse than posting nothing.



WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Draft Instagram captions and on-graphic copy in a specific, direct, plain-English Australian voice (I will give you the guide and examples)

- Choose the best format for each idea from a set library, so the feed stays varied and not repetitive

- Build posts in Canva using the pre-made branded template as the basis

- Adapt the same core content for 
 and
 (not create three separate programs)

- Schedule approved content

- Post and manage Stories

- Respond to comments and DMs in the brand voice, and recognise and escalate genuine enquiries to me quickly

- Do light weekly engagement and audience growth (real, relevant, no spam or follow-for-follow)

- Track basic metrics and send me a short weekly and monthly summary



This is a real scope for the hours, made possible by strong systems, templates and repurposing one core idea across channels rather than building three. We will agree priorities together around the available time. I would rather a few things done well than everything done thinly.



WHO THIS IS FOR:

You will do well here if you:

- Write genuinely well in English, with a natural, plain, professional tone. Australian spelling is required (organise, colour, recognise). No hype, no "unlock your potential", no marketing filler.

- Have real Instagram, 
 and
 experience for a business, not just personal accounts

- Are confident in Canva working from existing templates and a brand guide

- Use good judgment. You can tell the difference between something you can post and something you need to check first.

- Take initiative. You don't need every task broken into steps, and you'll speak up when you see a better way to execute an idea.

- Are careful and accurate. You would rather ask a question than guess.

- Can hold confidential information properly. You will never share or hint at who my clients are or what they are working on.

- Are reliable, communicative and happy in a long-term role



Nice to have, not essential: any exposure to B2B, professional services, construction or government-related content.



You don't need to arrive knowing tenders or procurement. I'll provide the technical substance and context, but I expect you to learn the language of the industry over time. You handle turning it into good social content.



NON-NEGOTIABLES

- Never invent facts, results, numbers, quotes or claims

- Never post client-identifying or confidential information

- Always use Australian English

- Always work from the strategy and brand guide, not your own guesses

- Ask when unsure



HOW TO APPLY: 

Applications that ignore these steps will not be read.

- Start your message with the word EVIDENCE so I know you read the full ad.

- Tell me in a few sentences why accuracy matters in a role like this, in your own words. No AI.

- Send one or two examples of social content you have written or managed for a business (link or screenshot).

- Do this short task:

Here is a boring, generic tip: "Read the tender documents carefully before you start writing your response."

Write ONE Instagram caption based on that tip, in a direct, plain, no-hype voice.

Then answer this in a few sentences:

You've drafted the caption and think adding the line "Most contractors lose marks because they don't read the tender properly" would make a stronger hook. You can't find that claim anywhere in the material I've provided. What do you do?



I am reading your application for tone, judgment and care, not length. A short, sharp, accurate application beats a long one.

title: Social Media Strategist & Short-Form Video Editor (US Real Estate)
description:
$10/hour | 15 hours a week | flat $650/month retainer, no time tracking | long-term



THE ROLE



I'm a real estate team lead in Pittsburgh, PA. Top 1% nationally, $115M+ sold, 119 families helped last year.



My YouTube channel has over a million views. My Instagram has 597 posts and 752 followers.



That gap is the job. My video content works when someone puts real effort into it, and social has never gotten that effort. There's no plan behind any of it. No formats, no strategy, nobody thinking about what's worth making. I post so the account isn't empty.



I'm changing that. One person owns Instagram,
, and TikTok completely. You build the plan, you tell me what to film, I film it, you turn it into something worth watching. I'm the talent. You're the director.



WHAT YOU'D BE WORKING WITH



I'm not short on material. 425 homes sold across Western PA, 119 families last year, listings at every price point all around Pittsburgh, and a team with their own closings.



You also won't be dragging content out of me. I've been on camera for years and I'll shoot what you ask for. Tell me the schedule that fits the formats you pick, whether that's batch days, on-site during listings, or something else, and I'll build my calendar around it.



What's missing is someone who knows which parts are worth telling and how to tell them.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- The plan. Recurring formats my audience recognizes, not random posts.

- The shot list and the filming rhythm. Tell me what to film, what to say, and when. You design the schedule, I'll hold it.

- Editing. My raw footage into short-form that holds attention.

- Posting and platform management. Cadence, captions, keyword and SEO, cover frames, stories, comment replies.

- Platform-specific treatment. I don't want the same file posted three times. Each platform gets what it rewards, and keeping current on that is your job.

- Team requests. My agents have a steady stream of Just Listed and Sold properties. Build a template early so these are a photo swap, not a design project. Important, but never ahead of the strategic work.

- A profile overhaul in your first month: bio, highlights, pinned posts.



THE STANDARD



Five feed posts a week, three of them video, two cut from footage we shoot for the purpose. Stories running consistently. Comments answered inside 24 hours.



That's the floor, not the goal. Those 597 posts prove volume alone does nothing. If a post isn't good enough for your own portfolio, don't publish it.



Fifteen hours is tight for that list and I know it. If something has to give, it's volume, never quality.



To be clear about how the money works: this is a flat monthly retainer, not hourly billing, so a heavy week doesn't become a bigger invoice. But if we get a few months in and we both agree the work has outgrown 15 hours, we'll talk about moving to 20 and the pay moves with it. I'm not looking to squeeze 20 hours of work out of a 15 hour contract.



First 30 days are different. Build the templates, dial in the formats, and get it right. If your full 15 hours goes into two excellent videos and a system we can repeat, that's a win.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



- 2+ years editing vertical short-form for US clients.

- Strong design eye. Premium, modern, current.

- You have opinions and you share them. I expect options and a recommendation, not a question back to me. If my idea is boring, say so.

- No AI slop. I can tell when a caption was written by ChatGPT, and so can everyone else. The writing has to sound like me.

- Reliable internet, backup power, and a machine that edit video without stuttering.

- One 30-minute call per week at 8:00 AM US Eastern, which is your evening.



THE DETAILS



$650 per month, paid as a flat retainer twice monthly via Wise, transfer fees covered. Prorated 13th month bonus every December. No time tracking, no screenshots. Other clients are fine by me. You bring your own editing software. I provide Canva Pro, a company
, Google Drive with room for heavy video, Meta Business Suite access, and a commercial music license.



HOW TO APPLY



Three steps. Miss one and I delete it.



1) Start your message with SCROLLSTOP

2) Link your portfolio. Short-form video you edited, graphics you designed.

3) Go look at my Instagram: 
/tarasah. In 3 or 4 sentences, what do you think an agent like me should be known for, and why?



Shortlisted applicants get a paid test project, $50, before any offer. I don't ask for free work.

title: Direct Hire: Accounting Team Lead / Player-Coach (NetSuite & QBO)
description:
The Role:

We are a US-based fractional CFO and accounting firm looking for a high-level, player-coach accountant to manage a dedicated "pod" of clients.



You will be managing a small team and handling heavy transactional workflows. You will be responsible for overseeing 1-3 junior team members, managing the month-end workflows for a group of clients, and taking a major hands-on role with a significant client running on NetSuite.



This is a direct-hire role. No BPO, no agencies, no micromanagement.



Working Hours (Non-Negotiable):

You must be able to work US Eastern Time hours.



Initial Period: During your training and onboarding, you must start your daily shift between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM US Eastern.



Long-Term Flexibility: Once you are fully trained and have proven your competence, you will earn the flexibility to choose your own start time anywhere between 7:00 AM and 12:00 PM (Noon) US Eastern, depending on what works best for you..



What You Will Do (The "Player" - Hands-On NetSuite Execution):



Heavy Involvement in a Large Account: You will take a substantial role in managing the core daily accounting and the month-end close process in NetSuite for a large client.



Collaborative Workflow & Reporting: You will not be on an island. You will work under the direction of existing senior team members who currently support this account. As you get trained and take over the regular workflow, you will continue to report directly to those team members, as well as to the CEO.



What You Will Do (The "Coach & Fixer" - QBO & Team Leadership):



Hands-On QBO & Cross-Platform Work: Act as a lead accountant for a portfolio of US-based clients running on QuickBooks Online (QBO) and other platforms. If a junior team member makes a mistake or falls behind, you must be fully capable and willing to jump into the software and do the work correctly yourself.



Workflow Prep & Data Entry: You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves for foundational tasks. This includes manually loading bank transactions from PDF statements, prepping jobs/tasks for team members, and chasing down missing receipts.



Reconciliations & Month-End Reviews: Supervise and review the daily, weekly, and monthly work of 2-3 junior team members. You will complete bank reconciliations and execute the final reviews required for the month-end close across NetSuite, QBO, or any other platform our clients use.



Must-Haves:



Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Management.



Deep, verifiable hands-on experience managing both daily transactions and month-end closes in NetSuite and QBO under US GAAP.



Prior experience working in a vCFO, agency, or multi-client accounting environment.



A "no task is too small" attitude—you must be just as comfortable doing manual PDF data entry and bank reconciliations as you are reviewing a team's financial statements.



Strict adherence to the US Eastern Time working hours outlined above.



Bonus Points (Nice-to-Have):

Experience in any of the following industries: Manufacturing, Multi-channel E-commerce (Shopify, Amazon FBA, etc.), Construction, Legal, Healthcare, or Professional Services.



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY):

We use a strict filtering process. To apply, you must send us a message on this platform following these exact instructions. If these instructions are not followed, your application will be immediately deleted.



Make the subject line of your message EXACTLY: Pivotal - NetSuite Team Lead



Do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, answer this scenario in the body of your message using 4 sentences or less: If a junior accountant on your team is consistently categorizing transactions to the wrong location classes in QBO, how do you handle it, and what is the very first thing you look at when reviewing a messy Balance Sheet in NetSuite?



Attach your resume or provide a link to your LinkedIn profile.

title: Part-Time Supply Chain & Quality Assurance Assistant (E-commerce, Fashion)
description:
Hours: Starting at an estimated 1.5-2.5 hours/day, must overlap with our Customer Service Manager's shift (starts around 11:30 PM PH time / 5:30 PM Netherlands time). Hours will grow as order volume increases, and pay grows accordingly — see compensation details below.



About us:

We run two growing US-focused fashion dropship e-commerce brands (Shopify), together processing 35-50+ orders/day. The process is identical across both stores. We're looking for a detail-oriented part-time team member to handle supply chain and product quality tasks, working closely with our Customer Service team.



What you'll do:



- Review daily order status across both stores: flag delayed orders ("info received" over 4 days, "in transit" over 15 days or no tracking update for 3+ days) and follow up with suppliers

- Match customer complaints (forwarded by our CS manager) against what was actually shipped — determine if it's a fulfillment error or a product issue, and d
 next steps (fix / replace / discontinue)

- When a product is out of stock and the supplier only offers a similar alternative: judge whether it's close enough to ship, or whether it needs escalation (to us, or to CS to inform the customer)

- Run quality checks on products once they reach 3+ sales, and request/add size charts for those products to the product pages

- Monitor supplier pricing: flag price increases and ask suppliers why; check cost of goods vs. selling price (target under 31%, escalate anything near 33-35%)

- Negotiate pricing with suppliers when instructed



Who we're looking for:



- Strong attention to detail — this role involves judgment calls, not just data entry

- Experience working within the dropshipping industry required (e.g. as a VA, customer service agent, or supply chain assistant for a dropshipping business) — fashion dropshipping experience is a strong plus

- Comfortable communicating professionally with suppliers 
 templates provided)

- Reliable, able to work independently within clear guidelines



Compensation: Starts at approximately €120/month (1.5 hrs/day), though we currently expect the workload to be closer to 2-2.5 hours/day (~€
/month). Pay grows with order volume up to ~€350/month as the role expands. Pay scales as follows:



Hours/day Monthly pay

1.5 hrs ~€120

2 hrs ~€150

2.5 hrs ~€190

3 hrs ~€225

3.5 hrs ~€260

4 hrs ~€295

4.5 hrs ~€325

5 hrs ~€350



Schedule: Part-time, estimated 1.5-2.5 hrs/day to start (growing with order volume), overlapping with our CS team's hours

title: Experienced B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – US Businesses
description:
We are looking for an experienced B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to join our team and book qualified sales appointments with U.S.-based contractors.



Pay: $6/hour + $10 bonus for every lead that becomes a paying customer

Hours: 20–40 hours/week

Schedule: U.S. business hours

Location: Remote/Any Location





ABOUT THE PRODUCT



We sell an all-in-one marketing and communication package designed for contractors and local service businesses.



Our main hook is simple: we provide the business with a FREE website.



The full service is $297/month with no contract and includes:



- A professional website

- Business phone number

- Automatic text-back when a business misses a phone call

- A system to help generate more 5-star Google reviews



You do NOT need to close the sale.



Your job is to find the decision-maker, generate interest, qualify them, and get them onto our sales calendar. We handle the actual sales call and closing.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



We provide you with lists of completely cold U.S. contractor leads.



Your responsibilities include:



- Cold calling U.S. businesses

- Finding and speaking with the actual decision-maker

- Navigating gatekeepers

- Getting transferred or finding the decision-maker's direct contact information

- Introducing our offer and generating interest

- Qualifying prospects before booking them

- Booking appointments as soon as possible

- Following up through calls, texts, and
s

- Confirming upcoming appointments

- Preventing no-shows

- Following up with no-shows and getting them rescheduled

- Keeping accurate notes and lead statuses inside GoHighLevel

- Managing your own pipeline and follow-ups



You own the lead from the first contact until they ATTEND their scheduled sales meeting.



Once they attend the meeting, we take over.





WHAT COUNTS AS A QUALIFIED LEAD?



We do NOT want someone filling our calendar with low-quality appointments just to hit a number.



Before booking an appointment, you should determine that:



- You are speaking with the owner or another legitimate decision-maker

- The business is located in the United States

- They are an established contractor/service business

- They have been operating for at least 2 years

- They already have a Google Business Profile

- They are reasonably capable of paying $297/month

- They have genuine interest in learning more about our offer





PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



You must maintain at least a 50% appointment show rate.



We care about QUALIFIED appointments that actually show up, not simply how many appointments you can put on a calendar.



You are responsible for your leads until they attend the meeting. That means following up, confirming appointments, nurturing interested prospects, and rescheduling no-shows.





THIS IS NOT A SCRIPT-READING POSITION



We will give you a basic cold-calling script and teach you our offer.



From there, we expect you to use your experience.



You should be able to:



- Adapt the script to your conversational style

- Test different openings and approaches

- Handle objections naturally

- Figure out what messaging is working

- Improve your pitch over time

- Learn from your calls and results

- Have natural conversations instead of reading word-for-word from a script

- Update our script with what is most effective and document objection handling



We are NOT looking to teach someone how to cold call from scratch.





REQUIREMENTS



- Minimum 4 years of cold-calling / appointment-setting experience

- Experience cold calling U.S. businesses is REQUIRED

- B2B cold-calling experience

- GoHighLevel (GHL) experience is REQUIRED

- Excellent spoken English with clear, natural pronunciation

- Comfortable dealing with gatekeepers

- Strong objection-handling skills

- Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

- Strong follow-up and organizational skills

- Able to work independently without constant supervision

- Able to work U.S. business hours

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and working environment





COMPENSATION



- $6 USD/hour

- $10 bonus for every lead you generate that becomes a paying customer

- 20–40 hours per week

- Additional performance bonuses and increased compensation may be available for consistently strong performers





HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



- A brief description of your cold-calling experience

- How many years you have cold called U.S. businesses

- What types of businesses/products you've called for

- Your experience with GoHighLevel

- Examples of your performance/results in previous cold-calling roles

- Video recording of yourself speaking English minimum 1 minute long about this specific application and why you want the job. 

- Make sure you say what your favorite color is at the beginning of the video so that we know you read directions.



Applications without a voice or video sample will NOT be considered.





INTERVIEW PROCESS



Qualified applicants will be invited to an interview that includes LIVE MOCK COLD CALLS.



We will pretend to be potential customers and evaluate your ability to:



- Open a cold call

- Navigate the conversation

- Handle objections

- Communicate naturally

- Qualify the prospect

- Ask for and book the appointment



We're looking for someone who already knows how to sell over the phone, can work independently, and wants a long-term position where strong performance is rewarded.

7. PINTEREST

Signs

Design inspiration

Events

Weddings

Business branding

Promotional materials



Understand the difference between Pinterest content strategy and paid Pinterest acquisition.



8. LINKEDIN / B2B DIGITAL MARKETING

Companies

Marketing managers

Restaurants

Franchises

Schools

Organizations

Event companies

Contractors

Procurement teams

9. PAID SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY

Campaign architecture

Audiences

Objectives

Budgets

Placements

Bidding/optimization strategy

Prospecting

Retargeting

Testing

Scaling

Exclusions

Frequency

Creative rotation

Campaign analysis



The Creative Lead makes the creative.



You make sure the right creative reaches the right person.



10. CREATIVE BRIEFING



You must understand creative even though you are not our primary creative producer.



Example:



Instead of telling the Creative Lead:



"Make me five
 ads."



You should be capable of saying:



"We're targeting youth baseball-team managers. Price is not their biggest problem—ordering 15 different names and numbers correctly is. I want three 15-second videos built around simplifying team ordering. Give me one testimonial angle, one problem/solution angle and one demonstration."



THAT is marketing.



You provide the business/customer insight.



The Creative Lead turns it into excellent creative.



11. CREATIVE PERFORMANCE FEEDBACK



You will provide the Creative Lead with data.



Example:



Creative A:

High hook rate, low CTR.



Creative B:

Lower watch time but excellent purchase rate.



Creative C:

Strong CTR but terrible conversion rate.



Creative D:

Excellent ROAS but beginning to fatigue.



Your job is to interpret those results and request the next round of creative intelligently.



12. RETARGETING SYSTEMS



Build sophisticated retargeting journeys.



Examples:



Website visitor



Viewed shirt page.



> Shirt benefit advertisement.



Repeat visit



Still did not buy.



> Testimonial/social-proof advertisement.



Added to cart



Didn't purchase.



> Cart-recovery advertising +
/SMS.



Purchased



Remove from new-customer acquisition advertising.



> Cross-sell.



60/90/180 days later



> Reorder/win-back campaign where appropriate.



Different behavior should trigger different marketing.



13. FIRST-PARTY CUSTOMER DATA



Develop strategies around properly obtained customer data.

Purchase date

Frequency

Order value

Customer type

Geographic area

Lifetime value

Engagement

Lead vs. customer

Lapsed customer

Custom audiences

Exclusions

Retention

Reorders

Cross-selling

Prospecting/modelled audiences where supported



Follow applicable privacy and platform requirements.



14.
 MARKETING



Own
 strategy and deployment.



Build automated flows such as:



Welcome



New subscriber> introduction > value > proof > offer.



Abandoned Cart



Cart > reminder > benefits > proof > incentive if justified.



Browse Abandonment



Visited repeatedly > relevant product reminder.



Post Purchase



Confirmation > education > review > cross-sell.



Reorder



Expected replenishment/reorder timeframe > reminder.



Win Back



Customer hasn't purchased recently > targeted return campaign.



VIP



High-value customer > special treatment/offers.



15. SMS MARKETING

Abandoned carts

Promotions

Limited-time offers

Reorders

Product launches

VIP customers

Customer lifecycle campaigns

16. CROSS-SELLING & UPSELLING



Customers buying one product may need another.



Examples:

Yard signs > banners.



Custom shirts > signs.



Event printing > apparel.



Restaurant menus > uniforms/signage.

17. CUSTOMER LIFETIME VALUE



You must think beyond the first transaction.



Understand:

First-order value

Average order value

Purchase frequency

Repeat purchase rate

Customer lifetime value

Gross margin where provided

Payback period



Sometimes spending $100 to acquire a $75 first order can make sense.



Sometimes spending $20 to acquire a $75 order is terrible.



The answer depends on margin, repeat purchases and lifetime value.



Think like a business owner.



18. FUNNEL DEVELOPMENT



Create complete funnels.



Examples:



Social Ad > Landing Page > Purchase



or:



Video > Lead Form >
/SMS > Quote ? Sale



or:



Educational Content > Retargeting > Product Page > Purchase



or:



Customer List > Reorder Offer > Purchase



Every campaign should have an intentional next step.



19. LANDING-PAGE STRATEGY



You do not need to code the pages.

Recommend:

Offers

Layout

Social proof

Videos

Reviews

Forms

FAQs

Urgency

Guarantees

Mobile improvements



Work with our SEO/web team on implementation.



20. OFFER STRATEGY



A great advertisement cannot always overcome a bad offer.



Develop and test:

Quantity breaks

Free shipping

Bundles

Free design assistance

Limited-time offers

First-order incentives

Reorder incentives

Referral offers

Volume pricing

Seasonal promotions



Measure actual profitability.



21. A/B AND MULTIVARIATE TESTING



Develop disciplined experiments around:

Hooks

Audiences

Offers

Landing pages

Headlines

CTAs

 subject lines

SMS

Campaign structures



Do not change ten things and then claim you learned something.



Test intelligently.



22. MARKETING AUTOMATION



Design automated workflows using systems such as:

CRM systems

/SMS platforms

Lead forms

Webhooks/integrations where available

ManyChat

Other automation platforms



Example:

CRM >

23. CRM STRATEGY

Marketing should become smarter as our customer database grows.

Your value is strategy and growth.



26. SOCIAL MEDIA VA MANAGEMENT

title: Property Research Analyst — Philippines
description:
We are looking for a highly capable Property Research Analyst based in the Philippines to join our Australian property acquisition team.



This is an ongoing opportunity for someone who enjoys research, analysis, fact-checking and producing professional reports, and who is comfortable using modern AI tools to work efficiently and effectively.



The Role



Your primary responsibility will be to research and prepare Property Acquisition Overviews for residential property purchases for investors across Australia.



You will research and analyse:

• The property development

• The suburb and surrounding area

• Population and demographics

• Existing and planned infrastructure

• Employment and economic drivers

• Transport and connectivity

• Education and amenities

• Property-market fundamentals

• Supply and development activity

• Other relevant factors that may affect the location or development



We will provide the framework and core property documentation, including facades, floor plans, elevations, inclusions, property specifications, builder information and development materials.



You will not be required to research rental or sales evidence.



AI & Research



You will be expected to use ChatGPT, Manus AI, Google and other reliable research sources to work efficiently. Any reasonable expenses associated with these tools will be paid for by us.



AI is a productivity tool — not a substitute for judgement.



A key part of the role is cross-validation and critical review of information. You will need to challenge AI-generated information rather than simply accept it.



You must be able to:

• Cross-check information across multiple sources

• Verify important facts

• Compare and reconcile conflicting information

• Identify inconsistencies and discrepancies

• Challenge information produced by AI

• Determine whether information is accurate, relevant and current

• Use multiple AI tools to independently validate important information

• Apply sound judgement when sources disagree

• Produce clear, accurate and professional written reports



We are looking for someone who will effectively "challenge the data" — checking and cross-validating information across AI tools and reliable sources until there is a high level of confidence that the information is correct.



What We're Looking For



You should have:

• Excellent online research skills

• Strong written English

• Excellent attention to detail

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills

• Excellent fact-checking and information-validation ability

• Good computer skills

• The ability to work independently

• A high standard of written work

• Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT

• A strong work ethic and desire to continuously improve



Property experience is not essential. We are primarily looking for someone who is an excellent researcher, analyst and critical thinker.



Paid Practical Assessment



Your first assignment will be a fully paid practical assessment based on a real Australian property development.



We will provide an existing example to demonstrate our methodology, format and expectations. You will then research a different development and location and prepare your own Property Acquisition Overview.



This allows us to assess your:

• Research ability

• Accuracy and fact-checking

• Critical thinking

• Attention to detail

• Written communication

• Ability to cross-validate information

• Ability to use AI effectively without relying on it blindly



Report Format



Property Acquisition Overviews are prepared and presented using Canva and delivered as a professional PDF document.



You should therefore be comfortable working with Canva or be willing and able to learn it quickly.



Remuneration



AUD $15 per hour



Once you are familiar with our methodology and workflow, we expect a completed Property Acquisition Overview to generally take approximately 4–6 hours.



Initial assignments may take longer while you learn our process and reporting standards.



We currently anticipate approximately 1–2 packages per week, with the opportunity for significantly more work as our business grows.



This is intended to become an ongoing working relationship for the right person.



How to Apply



Please provide:

• Your CV

• A brief introduction about yourself

• Details of your research, analytical or report-writing experience

• Examples of previous research or reporting work, if available

• A brief description of your experience using ChatGPT, Manus AI or similar AI tools

• Your experience with Canva, if applicable



We are particularly interested in applicants who can demonstrate excellent research ability, critical thinking, attention to detail, strong written English and the ability to turn large amounts of information into a clear, accurate and professional report.



If you are the type of person who won't simply accept the first answer from AI, but instead investigates, cross-checks, challenges and validates information until you are confident it is correct, we would like to hear from you.

title: Website Developer & Digital Growth Manager
description:
Website Developer & Digital Growth Manager



**Full-Time | Remote | Philippines**



We are a growing U.S.-based marine services and online education company looking for an experienced **Wix Website Developer & Digital Growth Manager** to join our team full-time.



We currently operate a marine surveying company with multiple U.S. locations and are expanding into additional markets. We are also developing NAMVS, an online marine surveyor training and certification program.



## WIX EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



**Please do not apply unless you have professional experience building and managing websites using Wix or Wix Studio.**



We already have established websites and a strong SEO foundation. We need someone who can take ownership of **building new pages, expanding our websites, managing SEO, improving local search visibility, and supporting our digital growth.**



This is a hands-on position. We need someone who can actually **build and execute**, not simply recommend what we should do.



## Responsibilities



* Build and manage websites using **Wix / Wix Studio**

* Create new location and city pages as we enter new U.S. markets

* Build service pages, landing pages, and resource pages

* Expand and improve existing website content

* Perform keyword research and on-page SEO

* Manage local SEO for multiple U.S. locations

* Optimize pages for Google Search

* Manage Google Search Console

* Submit new URLs and monitor indexing

* Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles

* Improve Google Maps/local search visibility

* Create internal linking strategies

* Optimize titles, descriptions, headings, images, URLs, and schema

* Monitor keyword rankings and website performance

* Use Google Analytics and Wix Analytics

* Research competitors and identify new SEO opportunities

* Assist with Google Ads and digital marketing campaigns

* Improve website conversion and lead generation

* Work with our LMS designer to develop and grow the NAMVS training website



## Required Skills



**You MUST have experience with:**



* Wix or Wix Studio

* Website development

* SEO

* Local SEO

* Keyword research

* Google Search Console

* Google Business Profile

* Website content development

* Mobile/responsive website design

* Strong written English



Experience working with **U.S. businesses and multi-location service companies** is highly preferred.



Experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads, SEMrush, Ahrefs, schema, backlinks, and conversion optimization is a plus.



## What We Are Looking For



We want a **builder and problem solver**.



If we tell you:



> "We are opening a new location in Tampa, Florida."



You should be able to research the market, determine what website content is needed, build the Wix pages, optimize them for search, publish them, submit them to Google, connect them with our local search strategy, and monitor their performance.



We are looking for someone who can work independently without needing a detailed daily task list.



We actively use AI tools such as ChatGPT and encourage our employees to use AI to improve productivity, research, content development, and analysis.



## This Is NOT a Social Media Position



We already have another employee handling social media.



Your primary responsibilities will be:



**Wix Website Development + SEO + Local SEO + Google Business Profiles + Digital Growth**



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume/CV

2. Links to **at least 3 Wix or Wix Studio websites** you have worked on

3. Explain what you personally built or managed on those websites

4. Examples of SEO or local SEO work you have completed

5. Any measurable results you achieved, such as increased traffic, rankings, leads, or conversions

6. The SEO/website tools you regularly use

7. Your experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT

8. Your expected monthly salary for full-time employment

9. Your availability/start date



### IMPORTANT



**Applications without examples of previous Wix work will not be considered.**



Please also answer this question in your application:



**If we were opening our marine surveying company in a new U.S. city, what would you do during your first 30 days to build our website and Google search presence in that market?**



We are looking for a talented, reliable person interested in a **long-term position** and the opportunity to grow with our companies as we continue expanding throughout the United States.
